           StringFind(s, "SFV VOL") >= 0);
}

// Helpers: Boom-like (Boom + Gainx) et Crash-like (Crash + Painx)
bool IsBoomLikeSymbol(const string symbol)
{
   string s = symbol;
   StringToUpper(s);
   return (StringFind(s, "BOOM") >= 0 || StringFind(s, "GAINX") >= 0);
}
bool IsCrashLikeSymbol(const string symbol)
{
   string s = symbol;
   StringToUpper(s);
   return (StringFind(s, "CRASH") >= 0 || StringFind(s, "PAINX") >= 0);
}

// Règle directionnelle spécifique Boom/Crash:
// - Sur Boom/Gainx: uniquement BUY (jamais SELL)
// - Sur Crash/Painx: uniquement SELL (jamais BUY)
// EXCEPTION: Mode Loss Recover autorise BUY sur PainX et SELL sur GainX
bool IsDirectionAllowedForBoomCrash(const string symbol, const string action)
{
   string a = action;
   StringToUpper(a);

   // FIX v1.30: Loss Recover exception - autoriser BUY sur PainX et SELL sur GainX
   if(g_lossRecoverArmed && g_lossRecoverSymbol == symbol)
   {
      int dirSign = (a == "BUY") ? 1 : -1;
      if(IsCrashLikeSymbol(symbol) && a == "BUY")
      {
         // PainX BUY autorisé en Loss Recover si conditions strictes OK
         if(SMC_LossRecoverConditionsOK(symbol, dirSign))
         {
            Print("🔄 LOSS RECOVER - BUY autorisé sur PainX ", symbol);
            return true;
         }
         else
         {
            Print("❌ LOSS RECOVER - BUY refusé sur PainX ", symbol, " (conditions non remplies)");
            return false;
         }
      }
      if(IsBoomLikeSymbol(symbol) && a == "SELL")
      {
         // GainX SELL autorisé en Loss Recover si conditions strictes OK
         if(SMC_LossRecoverConditionsOK(symbol, dirSign))
         {
            Print("🔄 LOSS RECOVER - SELL autorisé sur GainX ", symbol);
            return true;
         }
         else
         {
            Print("❌ LOSS RECOVER - SELL refusé sur GainX ", symbol, " (conditions non remplies)");
            return false;
         }
      }
   }

   if(IsBoomLikeSymbol(symbol) && a == "SELL")
      return false;
    if(IsCrashLikeSymbol(symbol) && a == "BUY")
       return false;
    return true;
}

//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| Détecte si le prix est en zone de correction/correction          |
//| Retourne true si en correction → bloquer les LIMIT DOW           |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
// Helper: obtenir le trend EMA21 vs EMA50 sur un TF
int GetEMATrend(const string symbol, const ENUM_TIMEFRAMES tf)
{
   double emaBuf[];
   ArraySetAsSeries(emaBuf, true);
   double ema21 = 0, ema50 = 0;
   int ema21H = iMA(symbol, tf, 21, 0, MODE_EMA, PRICE_CLOSE);
   int ema50H = iMA(symbol, tf, 50, 0, MODE_EMA, PRICE_CLOSE);
   if(ema21H != INVALID_HANDLE && ema50H != INVALID_HANDLE)
   {
      if(CopyBuffer(ema21H, 0, 0, 1, emaBuf) >= 1) ema21 = emaBuf[0];
      if(CopyBuffer(ema50H, 0, 0, 1, emaBuf) >= 1) ema50 = emaBuf[0];
   }
   if(ema21 > ema50) return 1;  // Bullish
   if(ema21 < ema50) return -1; // Bearish
   return 0; // Neutre
}

bool SMC_IsCorrectionZoneForDirection(const string symbol, const int dirSign)
{
   // NOUVELLE LOGIQUE: Bloquer SEULEMENT si M1 va changer de direction par rapport aux autres TF
   // Si tous les TF (H1, M15, M5, M1) sont alignés dans le même sens → PAS de blocage
   // Si M1 est dans le sens opposé à H1/M15/M5 → blocage (changement de direction imminent)

   // 1) Déterminer la direction du trend sur chaque TF via EMA21 vs EMA50
   int m1Trend = GetEMATrend(symbol, PERIOD_M1);
   int m5Trend = GetEMATrend(symbol, PERIOD_M5);
   int m15Trend = GetEMATrend(symbol, PERIOD_M15);
   int h1Trend = GetEMATrend(symbol, PERIOD_H1);

   // 2) Compter combien de TF sont alignés avec la direction demandée
   int alignedTF = 0;
   if(m1Trend == dirSign) alignedTF++;
   if(m5Trend == dirSign) alignedTF++;
   if(m15Trend == dirSign) alignedTF++;
   if(h1Trend == dirSign) alignedTF++;

   // 3) Logique de blocage:
   // - Si M1 est OPPOSÉ à la direction demandée ET que les autres TF (M5, M15, H1) sont alignés avec la direction
   //   → C'est un changement de direction imminent sur M1 → BLOQUER
   // - Si M1 est aligné avec la direction demandée → PAS de blocage (continuité de tendance)
   // - Si les TF sont divergents (pas clair) → PAS de blocage (laissons le verdict GOM décider)

   // Cas 1: M1 opposé à la direction demandée
   if(m1Trend != 0 && m1Trend != dirSign)
   {
      // Vérifier si les autres TF (M5, M15, H1) sont alignés avec la direction demandée
      int higherTFAligned = 0;
      if(m5Trend == dirSign) higherTFAligned++;
      if(m15Trend == dirSign) higherTFAligned++;
      if(h1Trend == dirSign) higherTFAligned++;

      // Si au moins 2 des 3 TF supérieurs sont alignés avec la direction mais M1 est opposé
      // → M1 va changer de direction → BLOQUER
      if(higherTFAligned >= 2)
      {
         Print("⚠️ CORRECTION détectée: M1 trend=", m1Trend, " opposé à dir=", dirSign,
               " mais M5/M15/H1 alignés (", higherTFAligned, "/3) sur ", symbol);
         return true;
      }
   }

   // Cas 2: M1 aligné avec la direction → PAS de blocage
   // Cas 3: TF divergents → PAS de blocage
   return false;
}

//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| VALIDATION NIVEAU SMC PRÉCIS — éviter entrées pêle-mêle         |
//| Exige que le prix soit à un niveau SMC clé + confirmation M5    |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
bool SMC_IsAtValidSMCLevel(const string symbol, const int dirSign, string &levelName)
{
   levelName = "";
   double price = (dirSign > 0) ? SymbolInfoDouble(symbol, SYMBOL_ASK) : SymbolInfoDouble(symbol, SYMBOL_BID);
   double atr = 0;
   int atrH = iATR(symbol, PERIOD_M5, 14);
   if(atrH != INVALID_HANDLE)
   {
      double atrBuf[];
      ArraySetAsSeries(atrBuf, true);
      if(CopyBuffer(atrH, 0, 0, 1, atrBuf) >= 1) atr = atrBuf[0];
   }
   if(atr <= 0) atr = SymbolInfoDouble(symbol, SYMBOL_POINT) * 100;
   double tolerance = atr * SMCLevelATRTolerance; // Tolérance configurable

   // 1) Support/Résistance 20 bars
   if(dirSign > 0 && g_impulseSupport20 > 0)
   {
      if(MathAbs(price - g_impulseSupport20) <= tolerance)
      {
         levelName = "Support 20 bars";
         return true;
      }
   }
   else if(dirSign < 0 && g_impulseResistance20 > 0)
   {
      if(MathAbs(price - g_impulseResistance20) <= tolerance)
      {
         levelName = "Résistance 20 bars";
         return true;
      }
   }

   // 2) DOW projected level
   double dowLevel = 0;
   bool dowBearish = false;
   if(SMC_FindDOWProjectedLevel(dowLevel, dowBearish))
   {
      if((dirSign > 0 && !dowBearish) || (dirSign < 0 && dowBearish))
      {
         if(MathAbs(price - dowLevel) <= tolerance)
         {
            levelName = "DOW Projected Line";
            return true;
         }
      }
   }

   // 3) GOM_TF_TL_M1 ou M5
   double m1Level = 0;
   if(SMC_FindReactionObjectLevel(symbol, "GOM_TF_TL_M1", m1Level) && m1Level > 0)
   {
      if(MathAbs(price - m1Level) <= tolerance)
      {
         levelName = "GOM_TF_TL_M1";
         return true;
      }
   }
   double m5Level = 0;
   if(SMC_FindReactionObjectLevel(symbol, "GOM_TF_TL_M5", m5Level) && m5Level > 0)
   {
      if(MathAbs(price - m5Level) <= tolerance)
      {
         levelName = "GOM_TF_TL_M5";
         return true;
      }
   }

   // 4) Pivot High/Low (20 bars)
   MqlRates rates[];
   ArraySetAsSeries(rates, true);
   if(CopyRates(symbol, PERIOD_M5, 0, 25, rates) >= 20)
   {
      for(int i = 2; i < 18; i++)
      {
         // Pivot Low (support)
         if(dirSign > 0 && 
            rates[i].low < rates[i-1].low && rates[i].low < rates[i+1].low &&
            rates[i].low < rates[i-2].low && rates[i].low < rates[i+2].low)
         {
            if(MathAbs(price - rates[i].low) <= tolerance)
            {
               levelName = "Pivot Low";
               return true;
            }
         }
         // Pivot High (résistance)
         if(dirSign < 0 && 
            rates[i].high > rates[i-1].high && rates[i].high > rates[i+1].high &&
            rates[i].high > rates[i-2].high && rates[i].high > rates[i+2].high)
         {
            if(MathAbs(price - rates[i].high) <= tolerance)
            {
               levelName = "Pivot High";
               return true;
            }
         }
      }
   }

   // 5) DOW BULL EP / DOW BEAR EP (Entry Point)
   string epToken = (dirSign > 0) ? "DOW_BULL_EP" : "DOW_BEAR_EP";
   double epLevel = 0;
   if(SMC_FindReactionObjectLevel(symbol, epToken, epLevel) && epLevel > 0)
   {
      if(MathAbs(price - epLevel) <= tolerance)
      {
         levelName = "DOW Entry Point";
         return true;
      }
   }

   // 6) FVG_DISP_TRAIL
   string fvgToken = (dirSign > 0) ? "SMC_DISP_FVG_TRAIL_Bull" : "SMC_DISP_FVG_TRAIL_Bear";
   double fvgLevel = 0;
   if(SMC_FindReactionObjectLevel(symbol, fvgToken, fvgLevel) && fvgLevel > 0)
   {
      if(MathAbs(price - fvgLevel) <= tolerance)
      {
         levelName = "FVG DISP TRAIL";
         return true;
      }
   }

   // 7) CHOCH/BOS (via détection structurelle)
   int bosDir = 0;
   if(UseBOS && SMC_DetectBOS(symbol, PERIOD_M5, bosDir))
   {
      if((dirSign > 0 && bosDir > 0) || (dirSign < 0 && bosDir < 0))
      {
         levelName = "BOS Structure";
         return true;
      }
   }

   return false;
}

//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| Confirmation M5 pour entrée SMC précise                           |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
bool SMC_HasM5Confirmation(const string symbol, const int dirSign)
{
   MqlRates m5Rates[];
   ArraySetAsSeries(m5Rates, true);
   if(CopyRates(symbol, PERIOD_M5, 0, 3, m5Rates) < 3) return false;

   double close0 = m5Rates[0].close;
   double close1 = m5Rates[1].close;
   double open0 = m5Rates[0].open;
   double open1 = m5Rates[1].open;

   // Confirmation BUY: bougie M1 bullish qui ferme au-dessus de l'ouverture
   if(dirSign > 0)
   {
      return (close0 > open0 && close0 > close1);
   }
   // Confirmation SELL: bougie M1 bearish qui ferme en-dessous de l'ouverture
   else if(dirSign < 0)
   {
      return (close0 < open0 && close0 < close1);
   }

   return false;
}

// Confirmation M15 : au moins une bougie M15 fermée récemment dans le sens
bool SMC_HasM15Confirmation(const string symbol, const int dirSign)
{
   MqlRates m15Rates[];
   ArraySetAsSeries(m15Rates, true);
   if(CopyRates(symbol, PERIOD_M15, 0, 4, m15Rates) < 3) return false;

   // r[0] = bougie en formation ; on exige confirmation sur bougies fermées
   for(int i = 1; i < 3; i++)
   {
      double close0 = m15Rates[i].close;
      double close1 = m15Rates[i + 1].close;
      double open0  = m15Rates[i].open;
      if(dirSign > 0 && close0 > open0 && close0 > close1) return true;
      if(dirSign < 0 && close0 < open0 && close0 < close1) return true;
   }
   return false;
}

// Contrôle de duplication de position:
// - Pas de duplication sur Boom/Crash (1 position max par symbole)
// - Sur autres marchés: duplication seulement si
//   * au moins 1 position existe déjà sur le symbole
//   * la première position est en gain >= 2$
//   * l'IA confirme la même direction avec >= 80% de confiance
bool CanOpenAdditionalPositionForSymbol(const string symbol, const string action)
{
   int existing = CountPositionsForSymbol(symbol);
   if(existing <= 0)
      return true; // première position toujours autorisée

   // FIX v1.12: jamais de 2e position (scale-in OFF)
   Print("🚫 CanOpenAdditional — déjà ", existing, " pos sur ", symbol, " — REFUS");
   return false; // v1.25: scale-in mort retiré (MQL5 n'accepte pas #if 0)
}

// Compte tous les ordres LIMIT (BUY_LIMIT / SELL_LIMIT) ouverts pour ce symbole (notre EA)
int CountOpenLimitOrdersForSymbol(const string symbol)
{
   int count = 0;
   for(int i = OrdersTotal() - 1; i >= 0; i--)
   {
      ulong ticket = OrderGetTicket(i);
      if(ticket == 0) continue;
      if(OrderGetString(ORDER_SYMBOL) != symbol) continue;
      if(OrderGetInteger(ORDER_MAGIC) != InpMagicNumber) continue;
      
      ENUM_ORDER_TYPE t = (ENUM_ORDER_TYPE)OrderGetInteger(ORDER_TYPE);
      if(t == ORDER_TYPE_BUY_LIMIT || t == ORDER_TYPE_SELL_LIMIT)
         count++;
   }
   return count;
}

// Compte uniquement les ordres LIMIT issus du canal SMC (commentaire "SMC_CH ...")
int CountChannelLimitOrdersForSymbol(const string symbol)
{
   int count = 0;
   for(int i = OrdersTotal() - 1; i >= 0; i--)
   {
      ulong ticket = OrderGetTicket(i);
      if(ticket == 0) continue;
      if(OrderGetString(ORDER_SYMBOL) != symbol) continue;
      if(OrderGetInteger(ORDER_MAGIC) != InpMagicNumber) continue;
      
      ENUM_ORDER_TYPE t = (ENUM_ORDER_TYPE)OrderGetInteger(ORDER_TYPE);
      if(t != ORDER_TYPE_BUY_LIMIT && t != ORDER_TYPE_SELL_LIMIT) continue;
      
      string cmt = OrderGetString(ORDER_COMMENT);
      if(StringFind(cmt, "SMC_CH") >= 0)
         count++;
   }
   return count;
}

// Forward declarations (defined in SMC_GOM_Pipeline.mqh, included later)
int  SMCGP_GetCachedVerdictNum(const string symbol);
bool SMC_GOMCurrentVerdictIsWait(const string symbol);
void SMCGP_EnforceLimitDiscipline(const long magic, const int maxLimits = 2);
bool LimitPlaceDisciplineOK(const string symbol, const int dirSign, string &reasonOut);
bool LimitCancelAllowed(const ulong ticket, const bool forceCounterTrend = false, const string reason = "");
bool LimitSafeOrderDelete(const ulong ticket, const bool forceCounterTrend = false, const string reason = "");
void LimitRegisterCancel(const string symbol);

// ── GATEKEEPER GOM: WAIT interdit + direction GOOD/PERFECT obligatoire ──
// dirSign: +1 BUY, -1 SELL. Retourne false si bloqué.
// BLOQUE TOUT: WAIT (vn=0), SIMPLE (|vn|=1), CONTRE-VERDICT
bool CanPlaceOrderByGOM(const string symbol, const int dirSign, const string orderKind)
{
   if(SMC_GOMCurrentVerdictIsWait(symbol))
   {
      Print("🚫 ", orderKind, " BLOQUÉ — ", symbol, " — verdict GOM courant WAIT");
      return false;
   }
   // FIX 2026-09-14: WAIT/OFF toujours bloqué, même si UseGOMVerdictFilter=false.
   SMCGP_RestoreCachedIfDisconnected();
   int vn = -999;
   if(SMCGP_GomLinkOK())
      vn = SMCGP_GetCachedVerdictNum(symbol);
   if(vn == -999 && symbol == _Symbol)
      vn = g_smcGomVerdictNum;

   if(!SMCGP_GomLinkOK() || vn == -999)
   {
      Print("🚫 ", orderKind, " BLOQUÉ — ", symbol, " — PAS DE VERDICT GOM / déconnecté");
      return false;
   }
   // WAIT (vn=0) : AUCUN ordre — sauf GOOD/PERFECT serveur + M1/M5/M15
   if(vn == 0)
   {
      SMCGP_RestoreAlignedGoodIfWait(symbol);
      vn = g_smcGomVerdictNum;
   }
   if(vn == 0)
   {
      if(SMCGP_SpikeAlignedGoodProtected(symbol, g_smcGomVerdictNumServer) &&
         ((dirSign > 0 && g_smcGomVerdictNumServer > 0) ||
          (dirSign < 0 && g_smcGomVerdictNumServer < 0)))
      {
         vn = g_smcGomVerdictNumServer;
         g_smcGomVerdictNum = vn;
         Print("✅ ", orderKind, " WAIT ignoré — srv GOOD/PERFECT + 3 TF | vn=", vn);
      }
      else if(g_secondSpikeInFlight && SMC_SpikePredictConfirms(dirSign))
         return true;
      else
      {
         Print("🚫 ", orderKind, " BLOQUÉ — ", symbol, " — GOM=WAIT (vn=0) — AUCUN ORDRE AUTORISÉ");
         return false;
      }
   }
   if(!UseGOMVerdictFilter) return true;
// SIMPLE (|vn|=1) : refusé si RequireGoodPerfectAlways (qualité A+)
    // Sinon autorisé uniquement sur symboles spike. Pas de bypass Dow.
    int minAbsVn = MinGOMVerdictNumAbs;
    if(!RequireGoodPerfectAlways && SMCGP_IsSpikeTradableSym(symbol))
       minAbsVn = 1;
    if(MathAbs(vn) < minAbsVn)
    {
       // FIX 2026-09-17g: IPA structure claire peut passer en SIMPLE
       if(g_ipaEntryInFlight && MathAbs(vn) == 1)
       {
          // autorisé — structure validée dans IPA_GOMAllows
       }
       else
       {
          Print("🚫 ", orderKind, " BLOQUÉ — ", symbol,
                " — GOM vn=", vn,
                " (exige |vn|>=", minAbsVn, " ",
                (minAbsVn == 1 ? "SIMPLE sur spike" : "GOOD/PERFECT"), ")");
          return false;
       }
    }
   // Contre-verdict interdit : le verdict DÉCIDE le trade
   if(dirSign > 0 && vn < 0)
   {
      Print("🚫 BUY ", orderKind, " BLOQUÉ sur ", symbol, " — GOM vn=", vn, " = SELL (verdict décide)");
      return false;
   }
   if(dirSign < 0 && vn > 0)
   {
      Print("🚫 SELL ", orderKind, " BLOQUÉ sur ", symbol, " — GOM vn=", vn, " = BUY (verdict décide)");
      return false;
   }
   return true;
}

bool CanPlacePatientSimpleOrderByGOM(const string symbol, const int dirSign)
{
   if(!UseGOMVerdictFilter) return true;
   int vn = (symbol == _Symbol && g_smcGomConnected) ? g_smcGomVerdictNum : -999;
   if(vn == -999) return false;
   if(vn == 0) return false; // WAIT: rien
   if(MathAbs(vn) != 1) return false;
   if((dirSign > 0 && vn < 0) || (dirSign < 0 && vn > 0)) return false;
   return true;
}

bool CanPlaceDowLimitByGOM(const string symbol, const int dirSign)
{
   if(!UseGOMVerdictFilter) return true;
   if(!g_smcGomConnected) return false;
   int vn = (symbol == _Symbol) ? g_smcGomVerdictNum : -999;
   // WAIT ou SIMPLE : pas de LIMIT DOW privilégié — exige GOOD/PERFECT
   if(vn == 0 || vn == -999) return false;
   if((dirSign > 0 && vn < 0) || (dirSign < 0 && vn > 0)) return false;
   if(!SMCGP_IsGoodPerfect(vn)) return false;
   return CanPlaceOrderByGOM(symbol, dirSign, "LIMIT");
}

bool CanPlaceMarketOrder(const string symbol, const int dirSign)
{
   // ── GARDE DIRECTION BOOM/CRASH: pas de SELL sur Boom/Gainx, pas de BUY sur Crash/Painx ──
   string dirStr = (dirSign > 0) ? "BUY" : "SELL";
   if(SMC_GOMCurrentVerdictIsWait(symbol))
   {
      Print("🚫 MARKET BLOQUÉ — ", symbol, " — verdict GOM courant WAIT");
      return false;
   }
   if(!IsDirectionAllowedForBoomCrash(symbol, dirStr))
   {
      Print("🚫 MARKET BLOQUÉ — ", symbol, " — direction ", dirStr, " interdite (règle Boom/Crash)");
      return false;
   }
   // FIX v1.14: WAIT + capital + spread
   if(!g_smcGomConnected || g_smcGomVerdictNum == 0 || g_smcGomVerdictNum == -999)
   {
      SMCGP_RestoreCachedIfDisconnected();
      SMCGP_RestoreAlignedGoodIfWait(symbol);
      if(!SMCGP_GomLinkOK() || g_smcGomVerdictNum == 0 || g_smcGomVerdictNum == -999)
      {
         if(SMCGP_SpikeAlignedGoodProtected(symbol, g_smcGomVerdictNumServer) &&
            ((dirSign > 0 && g_smcGomVerdictNumServer > 0) ||
             (dirSign < 0 && g_smcGomVerdictNumServer < 0)))
            ; // 3 TF + srv GOOD/PERFECT : CanPlaceOrderByGOM restaure
         else if(g_secondSpikeInFlight && SMC_SpikePredictConfirms(dirSign))
            ; // chaîne / jauge spike : laisser CanPlaceOrderByGOM décider
         else
         {
            Print("🚫 MARKET BLOQUÉ — WAIT/OFF sur ", symbol);
            return false;
         }
      }
   }
   if(!SMC_LowCapitalAllowsSymbol(symbol)) return false;
   if(!SMC_SpreadAllowsEntry(symbol)) return false;
   if(AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_MARGIN_FREE) < 1.0) return false;
   // ── GARDE TERMINAL GLOBAL ──
   if(IsTerminalFull())
   {
        Print("🚫 MARKET BLOQUÉ — Terminal plein (", CountTerminalAllOrders(), "/", MaxPositionsTerminal, ")");
      return false;
   }
   // Le contrôle anti-hedge/scale-in est exécuté juste avant l'envoi via CanTradeOnSymbol().
   // Ici, conserver uniquement le gate directionnel GOM afin de ne pas bloquer
   // les opportunités GOOD/PERFECT dans le même sens.
   return CanPlaceOrderByGOM(symbol, dirSign, "MARKET");
}

// ── GATEKEEPER: direction GOM + max 2 limit orders ─────────────────────
// Retourne true si l'ordre LIMIT est autorisé, false sinon
bool CanPlaceLimitOrder(const string symbol, ENUM_ORDER_TYPE orderType)
{
   // ── GARDE DIRECTION BOOM/CRASH: pas de SELL sur Boom/Gainx, pas de BUY sur Crash/Painx ──
   string dirStr = "";
   if(orderType == ORDER_TYPE_BUY_LIMIT || orderType == ORDER_TYPE_BUY)
      dirStr = "BUY";
   else if(orderType == ORDER_TYPE_SELL_LIMIT || orderType == ORDER_TYPE_SELL)
      dirStr = "SELL";
   if(dirStr != "" && !IsDirectionAllowedForBoomCrash(symbol, dirStr))
   {
      Print("🚫 LIMIT BLOQUÉ — ", symbol, " — direction ", dirStr, " interdite (règle Boom/Crash)");
      return false;
   }
   // ── GARDE TERMINAL GLOBAL ──
   if(IsTerminalFull())
   {
        Print("🚫 LIMIT BLOQUÉ — Terminal plein (", CountTerminalAllOrders(), "/", MaxPositionsTerminal, ")");
      return false;
   }
   // Gate anti-hedge commun aux ordres marché et pending. Il autorise au plus
   // un scale-in GOOD/PERFECT dans le MÊME sens, sous cap et cooldown.
   if(dirStr == "" || !CanTradeOnSymbol(symbol, dirStr))
   {
      Print("🚫 LIMIT BLOQUÉ — conflit, doublon, cooldown ou cap sur ", symbol,
            " direction=", dirStr);
      return false;
   }

   int dirSign = 0;
   if(orderType == ORDER_TYPE_BUY_LIMIT || orderType == ORDER_TYPE_BUY)
      dirSign = 1;
   else if(orderType == ORDER_TYPE_SELL_LIMIT || orderType == ORDER_TYPE_SELL)
      dirSign = -1;

   if(!CanPlaceOrderByGOM(symbol, dirSign, "LIMIT"))
      return false;

   string limReason = "";
   if(!LimitPlaceDisciplineOK(symbol, dirSign, limReason))
   {
      static datetime s_lastLimPlaceLog = 0;
      if(TimeCurrent() - s_lastLimPlaceLog >= 30)
      {
         s_lastLimPlaceLog = TimeCurrent();
         Print("🚫 LIMIT BLOQUÉ — ", symbol, " — ", limReason);
      }
      return false;
   }

   // Max 2 ordres LIMIT par symbole (garder les meilleurs via CleanupExcessLimits)
   int maxLimits = MathMax(1, MaxLimitOrdersTerminal);
   int total = CountOpenLimitOrdersForSymbol(symbol);
   if(total >= maxLimits)
   {
      Print("🚫 LIMIT BLOQUÉ — déjà ", total, " ordres limit sur ", symbol, " (max=", maxLimits, ")");
      return false;
   }

   return true;
}

// Supprime les ordres LIMIT les plus éloignés du prix courant si > max
void CleanupExcessLimits(const string symbol, int maxOrders)
{
   // Collecter tous nos limit orders
   struct LimitOrderInfo { ulong ticket; double price; ENUM_ORDER_TYPE type; datetime time; };
   LimitOrderInfo orders[];
   ArrayResize(orders, 0);

   for(int i = OrdersTotal() - 1; i >= 0; i--)
   {
      ulong ticket = OrderGetTicket(i);
      if(ticket == 0) continue;
      if(OrderGetString(ORDER_SYMBOL) != symbol) continue;
      if(OrderGetInteger(ORDER_MAGIC) != InpMagicNumber) continue;
      ENUM_ORDER_TYPE t = (ENUM_ORDER_TYPE)OrderGetInteger(ORDER_TYPE);
      if(t != ORDER_TYPE_BUY_LIMIT && t != ORDER_TYPE_SELL_LIMIT) continue;
      // Ne jamais supprimer un LIMIT DOW (ancré sur trendline PROJ)
      string cmt = OrderGetString(ORDER_COMMENT);
      if(StringFind(cmt, "DOW") >= 0) continue;

      // Grâce min discipline : ne pas supprimer un LIMIT trop jeune
      datetime orderTime = (datetime)OrderGetInteger(ORDER_TIME_SETUP);
      if(!LimitCancelAllowed(ticket, false, "CleanupExcessLimits"))
         continue;

      int sz = ArraySize(orders);
      ArrayResize(orders, sz + 1);
      orders[sz].ticket = ticket;
      orders[sz].price  = OrderGetDouble(ORDER_PRICE_OPEN);
      orders[sz].type   = t;
      orders[sz].time   = (datetime)OrderGetInteger(ORDER_TIME_SETUP);
   }

   int excess = ArraySize(orders) - maxOrders;
   if(excess <= 0) return;

   double currentPrice = SymbolInfoDouble(symbol, SYMBOL_BID);

   // Trier par distance au prix (plus éloigné en premier)
   for(int a = 0; a < ArraySize(orders) - 1; a++)
   {
      for(int b = a + 1; b < ArraySize(orders); b++)
      {
         double distA = MathAbs(orders[a].price - currentPrice);
         double distB = MathAbs(orders[b].price - currentPrice);
         if(distB > distA) // b plus loin → échanger
         {
            LimitOrderInfo tmp = orders[a];
            orders[a] = orders[b];
            orders[b] = tmp;
         }
      }
   }

   // Supprimer les plus éloignés
   for(int k = 0; k < excess; k++)
   {
      ulong tk = orders[k].ticket;
      if(!OrderSelect(tk)) continue;
      string cmt = OrderGetString(ORDER_COMMENT);
      if(!LimitSafeOrderDelete(tk, false, "CleanupExcessLimits " + cmt))
         Print("❌ Échec/suppression différée limit excessif ticket=", tk);
   }
}

bool SMC_DetectFVG(string symbol, ENUM_TIMEFRAMES tf, int lookback, FVGData &fvgOut)
{
   MqlRates rates[];
   ArraySetAsSeries(rates, true);
   if(CopyRates(symbol, tf, 0, lookback, rates) < lookback) return false;
   for(int fvgIndex = 2; fvgIndex < lookback - 1; fvgIndex++)
   {
      if(rates[fvgIndex-1].low > rates[fvgIndex+1].high)
      {
         double gap = rates[fvgIndex-1].low - rates[fvgIndex+1].high;
         double point = SymbolInfoDouble(symbol, SYMBOL_POINT);
         if(gap > point * 3) {
            fvgOut.top = rates[fvgIndex-1].low; fvgOut.bottom = rates[fvgIndex+1].high; fvgOut.direction = 1;
            fvgOut.time = rates[fvgIndex].time; fvgOut.isInversion = false; fvgOut.barIndex = fvgIndex;
            return true;
         }
      }
      if(rates[fvgIndex-1].high < rates[fvgIndex+1].low)
      {
         double gap = rates[fvgIndex+1].low - rates[fvgIndex-1].high;
         double point = SymbolInfoDouble(symbol, SYMBOL_POINT);
         if(gap > point * 3) {
            fvgOut.top = rates[fvgIndex+1].low; fvgOut.bottom = rates[fvgIndex-1].high; fvgOut.direction = -1;
            fvgOut.time = rates[fvgIndex].time; fvgOut.isInversion = false; fvgOut.barIndex = fvgIndex;
            return true;
         }
      }
   }
   return false;
}
bool SMC_DetectBOS(string symbol, ENUM_TIMEFRAMES tf, int &directionOut)
{
   MqlRates rates[];
   ArraySetAsSeries(rates, true);
   if(CopyRates(symbol, tf, 0, 20, rates) < 20) return false;
   double prevSwingHigh = MathMax(rates[3].high, MathMax(rates[4].high, rates[5].high));
   double prevSwingLow = MathMin(rates[3].low, MathMin(rates[4].low, rates[5].low));
   double point = SymbolInfoDouble(symbol, SYMBOL_POINT);
   double minBreak = point * 5;
   if(rates[1].close > prevSwingHigh + minBreak) { directionOut = 1; return true; }
   if(rates[1].close < prevSwingLow - minBreak) { directionOut = -1; return true; }
   return false;
}
bool SMC_DetectLiquiditySweep(string symbol, ENUM_TIMEFRAMES tf, string &typeOut)
{
   int barsAgo;
   return SMC_DetectLiquiditySweepEx(symbol, tf, typeOut, barsAgo);
}
bool SMC_DetectLiquiditySweepEx(string symbol, ENUM_TIMEFRAMES tf, string &typeOut, int &barsAgoOut)
{
   MqlRates rates[];
   ArraySetAsSeries(rates, true);
   if(CopyRates(symbol, tf, 0, 15, rates) < 15) return false;
   barsAgoOut = 99;
   double point = SymbolInfoDouble(symbol, SYMBOL_POINT);
   double minSweep = point * 5;
   for(int b = 1; b <= 5; b++)
   {
      if(b + 2 >= ArraySize(rates)) break;
      double prevHigh = rates[b+1].high;
      double prevLow = rates[b+1].low;
      double currHigh = rates[b].high;
      double currLow = rates[b].low;
      if(currHigh > prevHigh && (currHigh - prevHigh) > minSweep)
      {
         typeOut = "BSL";
         barsAgoOut = b;
         return true;
      }
      if(currLow < prevLow && (prevLow - currLow) > minSweep)
      {
         typeOut = "SSL";
         barsAgoOut = b;
         return true;
      }
   }
   return false;
}

//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| DÉTECTION CONSOLIDATION EN TEMPS RÉEL (2 segments de régression) |
//| Segment 1: Horizontal (range)                                    |
//| Segment 2: Pente (trend)                                          |
//| Déduit si le prix consolide, corrige ou a une impulsion franche    |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
struct ConsolidationData
{
   bool isInConsolidation;
   bool isInCorrection;
   bool hasStrongImpulse;
   double horizontalSlope;      // Pente segment horizontal (devrait être ~0)
   double trendSlope;           // Pente segment trend
   double rSquaredHorizontal;  // R² segment horizontal (qualité fit)
   double rSquaredTrend;       // R² segment trend (qualité fit)
   datetime lastUpdate;
   // Range box + cassure (ne reprendre BUY/SELL qu'après breakout)
   double rangeHigh;
   double rangeLow;
   double rangeWidthATR;
   bool   breakoutBuy;   // close au-dessus de rangeHigh
   bool   breakoutSell;  // close en-dessous de rangeLow
};

ConsolidationData g_consolidationData;

// Calcul régression linéaire simple (y = mx + b) et R²
bool CalculateLinearRegression(const double &prices[], const int startIdx, const int length, 
                              double &slopeOut, double &interceptOut, double &rSquaredOut)
{
   if(length < 3) return false;
   
   double sumX = 0, sumY = 0, sumXY = 0, sumX2 = 0, sumY2 = 0;
   int n = length;
   
   for(int i = 0; i < n; i++)
   {
      double x = i;
      double y = prices[startIdx + i];
      sumX += x;
      sumY += y;
      sumXY += x * y;
      sumX2 += x * x;
      sumY2 += y * y;
   }
   
   double denom = n * sumX2 - sumX * sumX;
   if(MathAbs(denom) < 1e-10) return false;
   
   slopeOut = (n * sumXY - sumX * sumY) / denom;
   interceptOut = (sumY - slopeOut * sumX) / n;
   
   // Calcul R²
   double meanY = sumY / n;
   double ssTotal = 0, ssResidual = 0;
   for(int i = 0; i < n; i++)
   {
      double x = i;
      double y = prices[startIdx + i];
      double predicted = slopeOut * x + interceptOut;
      ssTotal += (y - meanY) * (y - meanY);
      ssResidual += (y - predicted) * (y - predicted);
   }
   
   if(ssTotal < 1e-10) 
   {
      rSquaredOut = 1.0; // Parfait fit horizontal
   }
   else
   {
      rSquaredOut = 1.0 - (ssResidual / ssTotal);
   }
   
   return true;
}

// Met à jour la détection de consolidation
void UpdateConsolidationDetection(const string symbol)
{
   MqlRates rates[];
   ArraySetAsSeries(rates, true);
   int lookback = ConsolidationLookbackBars;
   if(CopyRates(symbol, PERIOD_M1, 0, lookback, rates) < lookback) return;

   // Si structure déjà connue: rafraîchir UNIQUEMENT la cassure chaque tick
   // (évite un lag de 30s pendant lequel l'EA pourrait encore trader le range)
   if(g_consolidationData.lastUpdate > 0 &&
      (TimeCurrent() - g_consolidationData.lastUpdate) < 30 &&
      g_consolidationData.rangeHigh > 0.0 && g_consolidationData.rangeLow > 0.0)
   {
      double atrQuick = 0.0;
      int atrHQ = iATR(symbol, PERIOD_M1, 14);
      if(atrHQ != INVALID_HANDLE)
      {
         double ab[];
         ArraySetAsSeries(ab, true);
         if(CopyBuffer(atrHQ, 0, 0, 1, ab) >= 1) atrQuick = ab[0];
      }
      if(atrQuick <= 0.0) atrQuick = SymbolInfoDouble(symbol, SYMBOL_POINT) * 50.0;
      double bufQ = atrQuick * MathMax(0.0, RangeBreakoutBufferATR);
      double c0 = rates[0].close;
      if(g_consolidationData.isInConsolidation)
      {
         g_consolidationData.breakoutBuy  = (c0 > g_consolidationData.rangeHigh + bufQ);
         g_consolidationData.breakoutSell = (c0 < g_consolidationData.rangeLow  - bufQ);
      }
      else
      {
         g_consolidationData.breakoutBuy  = true;
         g_consolidationData.breakoutSell = true;
      }
      return;
   }

   
   double prices[];
   ArrayResize(prices, lookback);
   for(int i = 0; i < lookback; i++)
      prices[i] = rates[i].close;
   
   // Segment 1: Horizontal (toute la période)
   double slopeH, interceptH, r2H;
   bool okH = CalculateLinearRegression(prices, 0, lookback, slopeH, interceptH, r2H);
   
   // Segment 2: Trend (dernières 15 bougies)
   double slopeT, interceptT, r2T;
   bool okT = CalculateLinearRegression(prices, 0, 15, slopeT, interceptT, r2T);
   
   if(!okH || !okT) return;
   
   g_consolidationData.horizontalSlope = slopeH;
   g_consolidationData.trendSlope = slopeT;
   g_consolidationData.rSquaredHorizontal = r2H;
   g_consolidationData.rSquaredTrend = r2T;
   g_consolidationData.lastUpdate = TimeCurrent();
   
   // Déduire l'état du marché
   double atr = 0;
   int atrH = iATR(symbol, PERIOD_M1, 14);
   if(atrH != INVALID_HANDLE)
   {
      double atrBuf[];
      ArraySetAsSeries(atrBuf, true);
      if(CopyBuffer(atrH, 0, 0, 1, atrBuf) >= 1) atr = atrBuf[0];
   }
   if(atr <= 0) atr = SymbolInfoDouble(symbol, SYMBOL_POINT) * 50;
   
   // CALCUL RANGE WIDTH (hauteur du range)
   double maxPrice = rates[0].high;
   double minPrice = rates[0].low;
   for(int i = 0; i < lookback; i++)
   {
      if(rates[i].high > maxPrice) maxPrice = rates[i].high;
      if(rates[i].low < minPrice) minPrice = rates[i].low;
   }
   double rangeWidth = maxPrice - minPrice;
   double rangeWidthATR = rangeWidth / atr; // Range en multiples d'ATR
   
   // ── RANGE BOX pratique (ce que l'œil voit sur le graphique) ──
   // Un range n'est PAS seulement un canal ultra-étroit (<0.5 ATR).
   // Sur FX Vol / synthétiques, une correction horizontale fait souvent 1–2.5 ATR
   // de large avec des bougies qui touchent haut ET bas du box.
   g_consolidationData.rangeHigh = maxPrice;
   g_consolidationData.rangeLow  = minPrice;
   g_consolidationData.rangeWidthATR = rangeWidthATR;

   // Oscillation: le prix a touché le tiers haut ET le tiers bas du box
   double third = rangeWidth / 3.0;
   bool touchedTop = false, touchedBot = false;
   for(int i = 0; i < lookback; i++)
   {
      if(rates[i].high >= maxPrice - third) touchedTop = true;
      if(rates[i].low  <= minPrice + third) touchedBot = true;
   }
   bool oscillating = touchedTop && touchedBot;

   // Pente horizontale (plate) sur le lookback
   bool flatSlope = (MathAbs(slopeH) < atr * ConsolidationSlopeThreshold * 3.0);

   // Corps moyens petits vs largeur du box → chop / range
   double avgBody = 0.0;
   for(int i = 0; i < lookback; i++)
      avgBody += MathAbs(rates[i].close - rates[i].open);
   avgBody /= (double)lookback;
   bool smallBodies = (rangeWidth > 0.0 && avgBody < rangeWidth * 0.22);

   // Consolidation = largeur raisonnable + (oscillation OU pente plate + petits corps)
   double maxRangeATR = MathMax(0.8, ConsolidationMaxRangeATR);
   bool widthOk = (rangeWidthATR > 0.15 && rangeWidthATR <= maxRangeATR);
   bool isHorizontal = widthOk && (oscillating || (flatSlope && smallBodies) ||
                       ((MathAbs(slopeH) < atr * ConsolidationSlopeThreshold) && (r2H > ConsolidationR2Threshold)));

   // Correction: pente trend faible + R² modéré
   bool isCorrection = (MathAbs(slopeT) < atr * ConsolidationSlopeThreshold * 2) &&
                        (r2T > 0.5) && (r2T < 0.8);

   // Impulsion franche: pente forte + R² élevé
   bool isImpulse = (MathAbs(slopeT) > atr * ConsolidationSlopeThreshold * 5) && (r2T > 0.8);

   // Cassure du range (close hors box + buffer ATR)
   double buf = atr * MathMax(0.0, RangeBreakoutBufferATR);
   double lastClose = rates[0].close;
   bool brkBuy  = (lastClose > maxPrice + buf);
   bool brkSell = (lastClose < minPrice - buf);

   // Si on n'est plus en range "structure", les breakouts ne servent à rien
   if(!isHorizontal)
   {
      brkBuy = true;   // marché libre → autoriser les deux sens côté filtre range
      brkSell = true;
   }

   g_consolidationData.isInConsolidation = isHorizontal;
   g_consolidationData.isInCorrection = isCorrection && !isHorizontal;
   g_consolidationData.hasStrongImpulse = isImpulse;
   g_consolidationData.breakoutBuy  = brkBuy;
   g_consolidationData.breakoutSell = brkSell;

   // Log pour debug
   if(isHorizontal)
      Print("📊 RANGE/CONSOLIDATION: ", symbol,
            " | box=[", DoubleToString(minPrice, _Digits), " - ", DoubleToString(maxPrice, _Digits), "]",
            " | width=", DoubleToString(rangeWidthATR, 2), "xATR",
            " | osc=", (oscillating ? "Y" : "N"),
            " | flat=", (flatSlope ? "Y" : "N"),
            " | brkBuy=", (brkBuy ? "Y" : "N"),
            " | brkSell=", (brkSell ? "Y" : "N"),
            " → attendre cassure avant entrée");
   else if(isCorrection)
      Print("📉 CORRECTION détectée: ", symbol, " | Slope T=", DoubleToString(slopeT, 6),
            " | R² T=", DoubleToString(r2T, 3));
   else if(isImpulse)
      Print("🚀 IMPULSION franche détectée: ", symbol, " | Slope T=", DoubleToString(slopeT, 6),
            " | R² T=", DoubleToString(r2T, 3));
   else
      Print("📈 MARCHÉ NEUTRE: ", symbol, " | Range=", DoubleToString(rangeWidthATR, 2), "x ATR");
}

// Vérifie si le marché est en consolidation (bloque les trades)
bool IsMarketInConsolidation(const string symbol)
{
   // La mise à jour est faite dans OnTick, ici on retourne juste l'état
   return g_consolidationData.isInConsolidation;
}

// Vérifie si le marché est en correction (autorise mais avec prudence)
bool IsMarketInCorrection(const string symbol)
{
   // La mise à jour est faite dans OnTick, ici on retourne juste l'état
   return g_consolidationData.isInCorrection;
}

// Vérifie si le marché a une impulsion franche (idéal pour entrées)
bool HasStrongImpulse(const string symbol)
{
   // La mise à jour est faite dans OnTick, ici on retourne juste l'état
   return g_consolidationData.hasStrongImpulse;
}

//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| Range box: autorise l'entrée seulement après cassure directionnelle|
//| BUY  → close au-dessus du high du range                            |
//| SELL → close en-dessous du low du range                            |
//| Si pas en range → true (filtre inactif).                           |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
bool SMC_RangeAllowsEntry(const int dirSign)
{
   // Nouveau module régime (ADX + structure + ATR + box + correction %)
   // Prioritaire si MR_Enable ; sinon fallback consolidation historique.
   if(MR_Enable)
   {
      string why = "";
      bool ok = MR_AllowsEntry(_Symbol, dirSign, why);
      if(!ok)
         Print("🔒 MARKET REGIME — entrée refusée ", (dirSign > 0 ? "BUY" : "SELL"),
               " | ", why);
      return ok;
   }

   if(!UseConsolidationFilter) return true;
   if(!g_consolidationData.isInConsolidation) return true;
   if(!RequireRangeBreakout) return false;

   if(dirSign > 0) return g_consolidationData.breakoutBuy;
   if(dirSign < 0) return g_consolidationData.breakoutSell;
   return false;
}

//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| DÉTECTION WHIPSAW GAIN/PERTE (oscillations rapides)            |
//| Détecte si le prix oscille gain/perte rapidement = range         |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
struct WhipsawData
{
   int gainLossTransitions;  // Nombre de transitions gain→perte→gain
   datetime lastTransitionTime;
   double lastProfit;
   bool wasInGain;
};

WhipsawData g_whipsawData;

// Met à jour le compteur de whipsaw pour une position
void UpdateWhipsawDetection(const double currentProfit)
{
   bool nowInGain = (currentProfit > 0);
   
   if(g_whipsawData.wasInGain != nowInGain && g_whipsawData.wasInGain)
   {
      // Transition détectée
      g_whipsawData.gainLossTransitions++;
      g_whipsawData.lastTransitionTime = TimeCurrent();
      Print("🔄 WHIPSAW détecté: transition #", g_whipsawData.gainLossTransitions,
            " | Profit: ", DoubleToString(currentProfit, 2), "$");
   }
   
   g_whipsawData.wasInGain = nowInGain;
   g_whipsawData.lastProfit = currentProfit;
}

// Vérifie si le marché est en whipsaw (trop d'oscillations)
bool IsInWhipsawMode()
{
   // Reset si trop ancien
   if(TimeCurrent() - g_whipsawData.lastTransitionTime > WhipsawResetMinutes * 60)
   {
      g_whipsawData.gainLossTransitions = 0;
      return false;
   }
   
   // Whipsaw si transitions >= seuil configurable
   return (g_whipsawData.gainLossTransitions >= WhipsawMaxTransitions);
}

// Reset whipsaw tracker (après fermeture position)
void ResetWhipsawTracker()
{
   g_whipsawData.gainLossTransitions = 0;
   g_whipsawData.lastTransitionTime = 0;
   g_whipsawData.lastProfit = 0;
   g_whipsawData.wasInGain = false;
}

bool SMC_DetectOrderBlock(string symbol, ENUM_TIMEFRAMES tf, OrderBlockData &obOut)
{
   MqlRates rates[];
   ArraySetAsSeries(rates, true);
   if(CopyRates(symbol, tf, 0, 50, rates) < 50) return false;
   for(int i = 3; i < 45; i++)
   {
      if(rates[i].close < rates[i].open && rates[i+1].close > rates[i+1].open)
      {
         double moveUp = rates[i+2].high - rates[i].low;
         double point = SymbolInfoDouble(symbol, SYMBOL_POINT);
         if(moveUp > point * 20) {
            obOut.high = rates[i].high; obOut.low = rates[i].low; obOut.direction = 1;
            obOut.time = rates[i].time; obOut.barIndex = i; obOut.type = "OB";
            return true;
         }
      }
      if(rates[i].close > rates[i].open && rates[i+1].close < rates[i+1].open)
      {
         double moveDown = rates[i].high - rates[i+2].low;
         double point = SymbolInfoDouble(symbol, SYMBOL_POINT);
         if(moveDown > point * 20) {
            obOut.high = rates[i].high; obOut.low = rates[i].low; obOut.direction = -1;
            obOut.time = rates[i].time; obOut.barIndex = i; obOut.type = "OB";
            return true;
         }
      }
   }
   return false;
}

bool SMC_PriceNearThickOB(const int dirSign, const double tol, double &obMid)
{
   obMid = 0.0;
   if(!UseOrderBlocks) return false;
   OrderBlockData ob;
   if(!SMC_DetectOrderBlock(_Symbol, PERIOD_M5, ob)) return false;
   obMid = (ob.high + ob.low) * 0.5;
   double bid = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);
   double ask = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK);
   double px = (bid + ask) * 0.5;
   if(MathAbs(px - obMid) > tol) return false;
   if(dirSign > 0 && ob.direction <= 0) return false;
   if(dirSign < 0 && ob.direction >= 0) return false;
   double obHeight = MathAbs(ob.high - ob.low);
   return (obHeight >= tol * 0.85);
}

bool SMC_IsLondonOpen(int hourStart, int hourEnd)
{
   MqlDateTime dt;
   TimeToStruct(TimeCurrent(), dt);
   return (dt.hour >= hourStart && dt.hour <= hourEnd);
}
bool SMC_IsNewYorkOpen(int hourStart, int hourEnd)
{
   MqlDateTime dt;
   TimeToStruct(TimeCurrent(), dt);
   return (dt.hour >= hourStart && dt.hour <= hourEnd);
}
bool SMC_IsKillZone(int loStart, int loEnd, int nyoStart, int nyoEnd)
{
   return SMC_IsLondonOpen(loStart, loEnd) || SMC_IsNewYorkOpen(nyoStart, nyoEnd);
}
double SMC_GetATRMultiplier(ENUM_SYMBOL_CATEGORY cat)
{
   switch(cat) {
      case SYM_BOOM_CRASH:  return 1.5;
      case SYM_VOLATILITY:  return 2.0;
      case SYM_FOREX:       return 2.0;
      case SYM_COMMODITY:   return 2.5;
      case SYM_METAL:       return 2.5;
      case SYM_CRYPTO:      return 3.0;
      default:              return 2.0;
   }
}

void SMC_ManagePurePAPendingLimits(const string symbol)
{
   int maxAgeSec = (int)MathMax(60, PurePA_LimitExpirySec);
   for(int i = OrdersTotal() - 1; i >= 0; i--)
   {
      ulong ticket = OrderGetTicket(i);
      if(ticket == 0) continue;
      ENUM_ORDER_TYPE type = (ENUM_ORDER_TYPE)OrderGetInteger(ORDER_TYPE);
      if(type != ORDER_TYPE_BUY_LIMIT && type != ORDER_TYPE_SELL_LIMIT) continue;
      if(OrderGetString(ORDER_SYMBOL) != symbol ||
         (ulong)OrderGetInteger(ORDER_MAGIC) != InpMagicNumber ||
         StringFind(OrderGetString(ORDER_COMMENT), "PURE_PA") < 0)
         continue;

      int dir = (type == ORDER_TYPE_BUY_LIMIT) ? 1 : -1;
      string invalidReason = "";
      datetime setupTime = (datetime)OrderGetInteger(ORDER_TIME_SETUP);
      if(setupTime > 0 && TimeCurrent() - setupTime >= maxAgeSec)
         invalidReason = "expiration contexte PurePA";
      else if(!g_smcGomConnected || MathAbs(g_smcGomVerdictNum) < 2 ||
              (dir > 0 && g_smcGomVerdictNum < 0) ||
              (dir < 0 && g_smcGomVerdictNum > 0))
         invalidReason = "verdict GOM devenu invalide";
      else if(!PurePA_UseLimitOrder)
         invalidReason = "ordres LIMIT PurePA désactivés";
      else if(PurePA_UseMultiTF && !PurePA_HigherTFAligned(dir))
         invalidReason = "alignement timeframe perdu";
      else
      {
         double sl = OrderGetDouble(ORDER_SL);
         double bid = SymbolInfoDouble(symbol, SYMBOL_BID);
         double ask = SymbolInfoDouble(symbol, SYMBOL_ASK);
         if((dir > 0 && sl > 0.0 && bid <= sl) ||
            (dir < 0 && sl > 0.0 && ask >= sl))
            invalidReason = "prix a invalidé le stop du setup";
      }

      if(invalidReason != "")
         LimitSafeOrderDelete(ticket, true, "PurePA: " + invalidReason);
   }
}

//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| Corps force dans .mq5 (evite bug MQL5 forward/.mqh)              |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
bool SMCPS_TryExecutePatternConfluenceEntry(const string symbol, const int dirSign, const string direction)
{
   if(!UsePatternConfluenceEntry || !UsePatternEntrySignals) return false;
   if(dirSign == 0) return false;

   // IRON: WAIT / OFF = aucune entrée pattern (le bypass AlignExec était un bug)
   if(!g_smcGomConnected || g_smcGomVerdictNum == 0)
   {
      static datetime s_patW = 0;
      if(TimeCurrent() - s_patW >= 45)
      {
         s_patW = TimeCurrent();
         Print("[PATTERN-CONFLUENCE] BLOQUÉ — GOM WAIT/OFF | ", symbol);
      }
      return false;
   }
   // Adaptive instrument filtering (Index Synthetics EA pattern)
   double adaptiveThreshold = SMC_AI_AdaptiveGOMThreshold(symbol);
   if(MathAbs(g_smcGomVerdictNum) < adaptiveThreshold)
   {
      static datetime s_patS = 0;
      if(TimeCurrent() - s_patS >= 45)
      {
         s_patS = TimeCurrent();
         Print("[PATTERN-CONFLUENCE] BLOQUÉ — SIMPLE vn=", g_smcGomVerdictNum, " | Adaptive threshold: ", DoubleToString(adaptiveThreshold, 1), " | ", symbol);
      }
      return false;
   }
   if(dirSign > 0 && g_smcGomVerdictNum < 0) return false;
   if(dirSign < 0 && g_smcGomVerdictNum > 0) return false;

   SMCPS_EnsureScanned(symbol);

   int effVn = SMCPS_EffectiveGOMVerdictNum();
   if(dirSign == 1 && effVn <= -2) return false;
   if(dirSign == -1 && effVn >= 2) return false;

   // Inline SMCPS_PatternConfluenceOK (evite undeclared selon ordre include MQL5)
   int confCount = (dirSign > 0) ? g_smcps.bullScore : g_smcps.bearScore;
   if(confCount < PatternConfluenceMinCount) return false;

   static datetime s_lastConfTry = 0;
   if(TimeCurrent() - s_lastConfTry < 5) return false;

   if(!SMCPS_BreakoutConfirmed(symbol, dirSign))
   {
      static datetime s_boLog2 = 0;
      if(TimeCurrent() - s_boLog2 >= 45)
      {
         s_boLog2 = TimeCurrent();
         Print("[PATTERN-CONFLUENCE] Attente breakout | ", direction,
               " | bull=", g_smcps.bullScore, " bear=", g_smcps.bearScore,
               " (seuil ", PatternConfluenceMinCount, ") | GOM vn=", g_smcGomVerdictNum);
      }
      return false;
   }

   s_lastConfTry = TimeCurrent();
   int count = (dirSign > 0) ? g_smcps.bullScore : g_smcps.bearScore;
   string tag = SMCPS_BestPatternTag(dirSign) + "_CONF" + IntegerToString(count);

   // Advanced Range Detection (EA Gold Stuff fix pattern)
   if(!SMC_Range_AllowEntry(_Symbol, g_smcGomVerdictNum))
   {
      Print("🚫 [PATTERN-CONFLUENCE] Entrée bloquée par détection de range | ", _Symbol);
      return false;
   }

   // Advanced Risk Manager (SpikeRider EA pattern) - check if trading allowed
   if(!SMC_Risk_AllowTrade())
   {
      Print("🚫 [PATTERN-CONFLUENCE] Entrée bloquée par gestionnaire de risque | ", _Symbol);
      return false;
   }

   // Pas de AlignExecBypass — FinalOpenGate + CanPlaceOrderByGOM restent actifs
   bool ok = PlaceGOMMarketOrder(direction, "GOM_PATTERN_CONFLUENCE", tag);

   if(ok)
      Print("[PATTERN-CONFLUENCE] MARKET ", direction, " | ", count,
            " patterns meme sens (seuil ", PatternConfluenceMinCount,
            ") | GOM vn=", g_smcGomVerdictNum, " | ", g_smcps.summary);
   else
      Print("[PATTERN-CONFLUENCE] ECHEC ", direction, " | ", count,
            " patterns meme sens mais ordre refuse | vn=", g_smcGomVerdictNum);
   return ok;
}

//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| CASCADE M15 -> M5 (lent, cassure confirmée) / M1 (rapide, scalp) |
//| Demande Sidoine 2026-09-19 : quand un pattern chartiste est      |
//| détecté sur M15, l'EA cherche une entrée sur M5 en attendant la  |
//| confirmation de cassure (lent), et une entrée sur M1 dès qu'un   |
//| signal apparaît, sans attendre de cassure (rapide/scalp), mais   |
//| avec des garde-fous de prudence (GOM aligné fort, pas de move    |
//| déjà étendu, lot réduit, anti-surtrading).                       |
//| Les deux volets sont indépendants : le scalp M1 n'empêche pas    |
//| l'entrée M5 plus tard si la cassure se confirme, et vice versa.  |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
bool SMCPS_TryExecuteM15CascadeM5Entry(const string symbol, const int dirSign, const string direction)
{
   if(!UseM15CascadeEntry || !UsePatternEntrySignals) return false;
   if(dirSign == 0) return false;

   if(!g_smcGomConnected || g_smcGomVerdictNum == 0) return false;
   if(MathAbs(g_smcGomVerdictNum) < MinGOMVerdictNumAbs) return false;
   if(dirSign > 0 && g_smcGomVerdictNum < 0) return false;
   if(dirSign < 0 && g_smcGomVerdictNum > 0) return false;

   SMCPS_EnsureScanned(symbol);

   int effVn = SMCPS_EffectiveGOMVerdictNum();
   if(dirSign == 1 && effVn <= -2) return false;
   if(dirSign == -1 && effVn >= 2) return false;

   // Déclencheur : pattern chartiste confirmé sur M15
   if(!SMCPS_HasQualifyingM15Pattern(dirSign, M15CascadeMinWeight)) return false;

   // Confirmation : un pattern doit aussi exister sur M5 dans le même sens
   bool hasM5Pattern = false;
   for(int i = 0; i < g_smcps.hitCount; i++)
      if(g_smcps.hits[i].dirSign == dirSign && g_smcps.hits[i].tf == PERIOD_M5)
      { hasM5Pattern = true; break; }
   if(!hasM5Pattern) return false;

   // Entrée "lente" : on attend toujours la cassure du niveau M5, jamais immédiate
   if(!SMCPS_BreakoutConfirmedOnTF(symbol, dirSign, PERIOD_M5))
   {
      static datetime s_boM5Log = 0;
      if(TimeCurrent() - s_boM5Log >= 45)
      {
         s_boM5Log = TimeCurrent();
         Print("[M15-CASCADE-M5] Attente cassure M5 | ", direction, " | ", g_smcps.summary,
               " | GOM vn=", g_smcGomVerdictNum);
      }
      return false;
   }

   // Un seul essai par fenêtre M15 (bougie M15 courante) pour éviter les doublons
   datetime m15Bar = iTime(symbol, PERIOD_M15, 1);
   static datetime s_lastM15BarBuy = 0, s_lastM15BarSell = 0;
   if(dirSign > 0 && m15Bar == s_lastM15BarBuy) return false;
   if(dirSign < 0 && m15Bar == s_lastM15BarSell) return false;

   string tag = SMCPS_BestPatternTag(dirSign) + "_M15CASC_M5";
   bool ok = PlaceGOMMarketOrder(direction, "GOM_M15_CASCADE_M5", tag);
   if(ok)
   {
      if(dirSign > 0) s_lastM15BarBuy = m15Bar; else s_lastM15BarSell = m15Bar;
      Print("[M15-CASCADE-M5] MARKET ", direction, " (entrée lente, cassure M5 confirmée) | ",
            g_smcps.summary, " | GOM vn=", g_smcGomVerdictNum);
   }
   else
      Print("[M15-CASCADE-M5] ECHEC ", direction, " | ordre refusé | vn=", g_smcGomVerdictNum);
   return ok;
}

bool SMCPS_TryExecuteM15CascadeM1ScalpEntry(const string symbol, const int dirSign, const string direction)
{
   if(!UseM15CascadeEntry || !UseM15CascadeM1Scalp || !UsePatternEntrySignals) return false;
   if(dirSign == 0) return false;

   if(!g_smcGomConnected || g_smcGomVerdictNum == 0) return false;
   // Le scalp n'attend pas de cassure : on exige en échange un GOM franchement
   // aligné (GOOD/PERFECT, |vn|>=2), jamais un simple SIMPLE — prudence.
   if(MathAbs(g_smcGomVerdictNum) < 2) return false;
   if(dirSign > 0 && g_smcGomVerdictNum < 0) return false;
   if(dirSign < 0 && g_smcGomVerdictNum > 0) return false;

   SMCPS_EnsureScanned(symbol);

   int effVn = SMCPS_EffectiveGOMVerdictNum();
   if(dirSign == 1 && effVn <= -2) return false;
   if(dirSign == -1 && effVn >= 2) return false;

   // Déclencheur : pattern chartiste confirmé sur M15 (toujours actif)
   if(!SMCPS_HasQualifyingM15Pattern(dirSign, M15CascadeMinWeight)) return false;

   // Signal M1 dans le même sens — entrée immédiate, pas d'attente de cassure
   bool hasM1Pattern = false;
   for(int i = 0; i < g_smcps.hitCount; i++)
      if(g_smcps.hits[i].dirSign == dirSign && g_smcps.hits[i].tf == PERIOD_M1)
      { hasM1Pattern = true; break; }
   if(!hasM1Pattern) return false;

   // Prudence : ne jamais scalper un mouvement déjà étendu
   if(!SMCPS_NotExtended(symbol, dirSign)) return false;

   // Anti-surtrading : 1 scalp par bougie M1 + cooldown mini entre deux scalps
   datetime m1Bar = iTime(symbol, PERIOD_M1, 1);
   static datetime s_lastM1BarBuy = 0, s_lastM1BarSell = 0;
   static datetime s_lastScalpTime = 0;
   if(dirSign > 0 && m1Bar == s_lastM1BarBuy) return false;
   if(dirSign < 0 && m1Bar == s_lastM1BarSell) return false;
   if(TimeCurrent() - s_lastScalpTime < M1ScalpCooldownSec) return false;

   string tag = SMCPS_BestPatternTag(dirSign) + "_M15CASC_M1SCALP";

   // Lot réduit pour ce volet scalp (prudence), via le multiplicateur global
   // déjà utilisé ailleurs pour les entrées à taille réduite (ex. contre-tendance).
   // NB: à vérifier que PlaceGOMMarketOrder() lit bien g_agentLotMultiplier —
   // fonction définie hors des fichiers fournis (probablement SMC_GOM_Immediate.mqh).
   double savedMult = g_agentLotMultiplier;
   g_agentLotMultiplier = savedMult * MathMax(0.05, M1ScalpLotMultiplier);
   bool ok = PlaceGOMMarketOrder(direction, "GOM_M15_CASCADE_M1_SCALP", tag);
   g_agentLotMultiplier = savedMult;

   if(ok)
   {
      s_lastScalpTime = TimeCurrent();
      if(dirSign > 0) s_lastM1BarBuy = m1Bar; else s_lastM1BarSell = m1Bar;
      Print("[M15-CASCADE-M1-SCALP] MARKET ", direction, " (entrée rapide, lot x",
            DoubleToString(M1ScalpLotMultiplier, 2), ") | ", g_smcps.summary,
            " | GOM vn=", g_smcGomVerdictNum);
   }
   else
      Print("[M15-CASCADE-M1-SCALP] ECHEC ", direction, " | ordre refusé | vn=", g_smcGomVerdictNum);
   return ok;
}

#include "modules/SMC_ProbabilityGate.mqh"
#include "modules/SMC_DowTrendline.mqh"
struct SpikeBlinkWatchState
{
   bool     active;
   int      dirSign;
   datetime barTime;
   double   price;
   string   message;
   bool     blinkVisible;
   uint     lastToggleMs;
   uint     lastRenderMs;
   uint     lastSignalMs;
};
SpikeBlinkWatchState g_spikeBlinkWatch;
void SMC_SpikeBlink_ClearWatchArrow();
void SMC_SpikeBlink_UpdateWatchArrow(const int dirSign);
void SMC_SpikeBlink_WatchArrowOnTimer();
#define G_SMC_GOM_EXTERN
#include "modules/SMC_SpikeBlinkDetector.mqh"
void SMC_SpikeBlink_ClearWatchArrow()
{
   ObjectDelete(0, "SPIKE_WATCH_" + _Symbol + "_ARR");
   ObjectDelete(0, "SPIKE_WATCH_" + _Symbol + "_LBL");
   g_spikeBlinkWatch.active = false;
   g_spikeBlinkWatch.dirSign = 0;
   g_spikeBlinkWatch.barTime = 0;
   g_spikeBlinkWatch.price = 0.0;
   g_spikeBlinkWatch.message = "";
   g_spikeBlinkWatch.lastRenderMs = 0;
}

void SMC_SpikeBlink_DrawWatchArrow()
{
   if(!g_spikeBlinkWatch.active || g_spikeBlinkWatch.price <= 0.0)
      return;

   uint nowMs = GetTickCount();
   bool phaseChanged = false;
   if(nowMs - g_spikeBlinkWatch.lastToggleMs >= (uint)MathMax(200, SpikeBlinkIntervalMs))
   {
      g_spikeBlinkWatch.blinkVisible = !g_spikeBlinkWatch.blinkVisible;
      g_spikeBlinkWatch.lastToggleMs = nowMs;
      phaseChanged = true;
   }
   if(!phaseChanged && g_spikeBlinkWatch.lastRenderMs > 0 &&
      nowMs - g_spikeBlinkWatch.lastRenderMs < 250)
      return;
   g_spikeBlinkWatch.lastRenderMs = nowMs;

   bool isBuy = (g_spikeBlinkWatch.dirSign > 0);
   bool isPreSpike = (StringFind(g_spikeBlinkWatch.message, "PRE-SPIKE") == 0);
   color onColor = isPreSpike ? clrGold : (isBuy ? clrLime : clrRed);
   color offColor = isPreSpike ? C'90,70,0' : (isBuy ? C'0,65,0' : C'70,0,0');
   color arrowColor = g_spikeBlinkWatch.blinkVisible ? onColor : offColor;
   string arrowName = "SPIKE_WATCH_" + _Symbol + "_ARR";
   string labelName = "SPIKE_WATCH_" + _Symbol + "_LBL";
   datetime t = (g_spikeBlinkWatch.barTime > 0)
                ? g_spikeBlinkWatch.barTime : iTime(_Symbol, PERIOD_M1, 0);
   if(t <= 0) t = TimeCurrent();

   if(ObjectFind(0, arrowName) < 0 &&
      !ObjectCreate(0, arrowName, OBJ_ARROW, 0, t, g_spikeBlinkWatch.price))
   {
      static datetime s_lastCreateError = 0;
      if(TimeCurrent() - s_lastCreateError >= 30)
      {
         Print("[SPIKE-WATCH] Échec création flèche | ", _Symbol,
               " | erreur=", GetLastError());
         s_lastCreateError = TimeCurrent();
      }
      return;
   }

   ObjectMove(0, arrowName, 0, t, g_spikeBlinkWatch.price);
   ObjectSetInteger(0, arrowName, OBJPROP_ARROWCODE, isBuy ? 233 : 234);
   ObjectSetInteger(0, arrowName, OBJPROP_WIDTH, 5);
   ObjectSetInteger(0, arrowName, OBJPROP_ANCHOR, isBuy ? ANCHOR_TOP : ANCHOR_BOTTOM);
   ObjectSetInteger(0, arrowName, OBJPROP_COLOR, arrowColor);
   ObjectSetInteger(0, arrowName, OBJPROP_BACK, false);
   ObjectSetInteger(0, arrowName, OBJPROP_SELECTABLE, false);
   ObjectSetInteger(0, arrowName, OBJPROP_HIDDEN, true);
   ObjectSetInteger(0, arrowName, OBJPROP_TIMEFRAMES, OBJ_ALL_PERIODS);
   ObjectSetString(0, arrowName, OBJPROP_TOOLTIP, g_spikeBlinkWatch.message);

   if(ObjectFind(0, labelName) < 0 &&
      !ObjectCreate(0, labelName, OBJ_TEXT, 0, t, g_spikeBlinkWatch.price))
   {
      static datetime s_lastLabelError = 0;
      if(TimeCurrent() - s_lastLabelError >= 30)
      {
         Print("[SPIKE-WATCH] Échec création libellé | ", _Symbol,
               " | erreur=", GetLastError());
         s_lastLabelError = TimeCurrent();
      }
      ChartRedraw(0);
      return;
   }

   ObjectMove(0, labelName, 0, t, g_spikeBlinkWatch.price);
   ObjectSetString(0, labelName, OBJPROP_TEXT,
                   g_spikeBlinkWatch.blinkVisible ? g_spikeBlinkWatch.message : " ");
   ObjectSetString(0, labelName, OBJPROP_FONT, "Arial Bold");
   ObjectSetInteger(0, labelName, OBJPROP_FONTSIZE, 10);
   ObjectSetInteger(0, labelName, OBJPROP_ANCHOR, isBuy ? ANCHOR_UPPER : ANCHOR_LOWER);
   ObjectSetInteger(0, labelName, OBJPROP_COLOR, arrowColor);
   ObjectSetInteger(0, labelName, OBJPROP_BACK, false);
   ObjectSetInteger(0, labelName, OBJPROP_SELECTABLE, false);
   ObjectSetInteger(0, labelName, OBJPROP_HIDDEN, true);
   ObjectSetInteger(0, labelName, OBJPROP_TIMEFRAMES, OBJ_ALL_PERIODS);
   ChartRedraw(0);
}

void SMC_SpikeBlink_UpdateWatchArrow(const int dirSign)
{
   if(!SpikeShowArrows || dirSign == 0)
   {
      SMC_SpikeBlink_ClearWatchArrow();
      return;
   }

   MqlRates rates[];
   ArraySetAsSeries(rates, true);
   if(CopyRates(_Symbol, PERIOD_M1, 0, 1, rates) < 1)
      return;

   datetime spikeBar = 0;
   double spikePrice = 0.0;
   bool liveSpike = SMC_SpikeBlink_LiveCandle(dirSign, spikeBar, spikePrice);
   bool preSpike = (g_spikeChainState == SPIKE_STATE_PRE_SPIKE);
   bool activeChain = (g_spikeChainState == SPIKE_STATE_CHAIN_ACTIVE &&
                       g_spikeChainDirection == dirSign &&
                       g_spikeChainStrongBars >= 2);
   bool freshHighProbability = (g_lastSpikeUpdate > 0 &&
                                TimeCurrent() >= g_lastSpikeUpdate &&
                                TimeCurrent() - g_lastSpikeUpdate <= 60 &&
                                g_lastSpikeProbability >= 0.75);

   if(!liveSpike && !preSpike && !activeChain && !freshHighProbability)
   {
      SMC_SpikeBlink_ClearWatchArrow();
      return;
   }

   string message = liveSpike ? "SPIKE DETECTE"
                    : activeChain ? "CHAINE SPIKE ACTIVE"
                    : preSpike ? "PRE-SPIKE - A SURVEILLER"
                    : "SPIKE POSSIBLE";
   double range = rates[0].high - rates[0].low;
   double offset = MathMax(range * 0.25, _Point * 20.0);
   double price = liveSpike ? spikePrice
                  : (dirSign > 0 ? rates[0].low - offset : rates[0].high + offset);
   datetime barTime = liveSpike ? spikeBar : rates[0].time;

   if(!g_spikeBlinkWatch.active ||
      g_spikeBlinkWatch.dirSign != dirSign ||
      g_spikeBlinkWatch.message != message)
   {
      g_spikeBlinkWatch.blinkVisible = true;
      g_spikeBlinkWatch.lastToggleMs = GetTickCount();
      g_spikeBlinkWatch.lastRenderMs = 0;
   }
   g_spikeBlinkWatch.active = true;
   g_spikeBlinkWatch.dirSign = dirSign;
   g_spikeBlinkWatch.barTime = barTime;
   g_spikeBlinkWatch.price = price;
   g_spikeBlinkWatch.message = message;
   g_spikeBlinkWatch.lastSignalMs = GetTickCount();
   SMC_SpikeBlink_DrawWatchArrow();
}

void SMC_SpikeBlink_WatchArrowOnTimer()
{
   if(!g_spikeBlinkWatch.active)
      return;
   if(GetTickCount() - g_spikeBlinkWatch.lastSignalMs > 30000)
   {
      SMC_SpikeBlink_ClearWatchArrow();
      return;
   }
   SMC_SpikeBlink_DrawWatchArrow();
}

void SMC_SpikeBlink_Deinit()
{
   SMC_SpikeBlink_ClearWatchArrow();
   if(g_spikeBlinkAtrHandle != INVALID_HANDLE)
   {
      IndicatorRelease(g_spikeBlinkAtrHandle);
      g_spikeBlinkAtrHandle = INVALID_HANDLE;
   }
}

bool SMC_IsGoldProfileActive()
{
   return UseGoldHybridProfile && SMC_GetSymbolCategory(_Symbol) == SYM_METAL;
}
bool SMC_IsForexProfileActive()
{
   return UseForexProfile && SMC_GetSymbolCategory(_Symbol) == SYM_FOREX;
}
bool SMC_IsCryptoProfileActive()
{
   return UseCryptoProfile && SMC_GetSymbolCategory(_Symbol) == SYM_CRYPTO;
}

double SMC_EffectiveSLMult()
{
   if(SMC_IsGoldProfileActive())   return GoldSL_ATRMult;
   if(SMC_IsForexProfileActive())  return ForexSL_ATRMult;
   if(SMC_IsCryptoProfileActive()) return CryptoSL_ATRMult;
   return SL_ATRMult;
}

double SMC_EffectiveTPMult()
{
   double base;
   if(SMC_IsGoldProfileActive())   base = GoldTP_ATRMult;
   else if(SMC_IsForexProfileActive())  base = ForexTP_ATRMult;
   else if(SMC_IsCryptoProfileActive()) base = CryptoTP_ATRMult;
   else base = TP_ATRMult;

   if(UseAIServer && g_agentLastUpdate > 0 && g_agentRegime != "")
   {
      if(g_agentRegime == "TRENDING_UP" || g_agentRegime == "TRENDING_DOWN")
         base *= 1.30;
      else if(g_agentRegime == "BREAKOUT")
         base *= 1.15;
      else if(g_agentRegime == "RANGING")
         base *= 0.80;
      else if(g_agentRegime == "VOLATILE")
         base *= 0.70;
   }
   return base;
}

double SMC_EffectiveMaxDailyDDPct()
{
   if(SMC_IsGoldProfileActive())   return GoldMaxDailyLossPct;
   if(SMC_IsForexProfileActive())  return ForexMaxDailyLossPct;
   if(SMC_IsCryptoProfileActive()) return CryptoMaxDailyLossPct;
   return MaxDailyDrawdownPercent;
}

   if(SMC_IsGoldProfileActive())   return GoldMaxRiskPct;
   if(SMC_IsForexProfileActive())  return ForexMaxRiskPct;
   if(SMC_IsCryptoProfileActive()) return CryptoMaxRiskPct;
   return MaxRiskPerTradePercent;
}

int SMC_EffectiveMaxPositionsTerminal()
{

      cap = MathMin(cap, GoldMaxPositions);

{

   if(SMC_IsForexProfileActive())  return ForexGOMMinCoherencePct;

   if(SMC_GetSymbolCategory(_Symbol) == SYM_BOOM_CRASH
      || SMC_GetSymbolCategory(_Symbol) == SYM_VOLATILITY)
      return 25.0;
   return GOMMinCoherencePct;

bool SMC_IsInProfileSessionWindow()
{
   MqlDateTime dt;
   TimeToStruct(TimeCurrent(), dt);
   int h = dt.hour;
   if(SMC_IsForexProfileActive() && ForexUseSessionFilter)
      return (h >= ForexSessionStart && h < ForexSessionEnd);
   if(SMC_IsCryptoProfileActive() && CryptoUseSessionFilter)
      return (h >= CryptoSessionStart && h < CryptoSessionEnd);
   return true;
}

// Vérifie si on est dans une session Volatility optimale (2 fenêtres UTC)
bool SMC_IsVolSessionActive()
{
   if(!VolUseSessionFilter) return true;
   if(SMC_GetSymbolCategory(_Symbol) != SYM_VOLATILITY) return true;
   MqlDateTime dt;
   TimeToStruct(TimeCurrent(), dt);
   int h = dt.hour;
   bool inSession1 = (h >= VolSessionStart1 && h < VolSessionEnd1);
   bool inSession2 = (h >= VolSessionStart2 && h < VolSessionEnd2);
   return (inSession1 || inSession2);
}

int SMC_GetGoldRegimeW1()
{
   if(!GoldUseRegimeFilter) return 1;
   if(TimeCurrent() - g_goldRegimeUpdate < 300) return g_goldRegime;

   if(g_goldRegimeW1_50  == INVALID_HANDLE) g_goldRegimeW1_50  = iMA(_Symbol, PERIOD_W1, 50,  0, MODE_EMA, PRICE_CLOSE);
   if(g_goldRegimeW1_200 == INVALID_HANDLE) g_goldRegimeW1_200 = iMA(_Symbol, PERIOD_W1, 200, 0, MODE_EMA, PRICE_CLOSE);
   if(g_goldRegimeW1_50 == INVALID_HANDLE || g_goldRegimeW1_200 == INVALID_HANDLE) return g_goldRegime;

   double buf50[], buf200[];
   ArraySetAsSeries(buf50, true); ArraySetAsSeries(buf200, true);
   if(CopyBuffer(g_goldRegimeW1_50,  0, 0, 2, buf50)  < 2) return g_goldRegime;
   if(CopyBuffer(g_goldRegimeW1_200, 0, 0, 2, buf200) < 2) return g_goldRegime;

   double ema50  = buf50[1];
   double ema200 = buf200[1];
   if(ema200 <= 0) return g_goldRegime;

   double thresh = ema200 * 0.005;
   int newRegime;
   if(ema50 > ema200 + thresh)       newRegime = 1;
   else if(ema50 < ema200 - thresh)  newRegime = -1;
   else                               newRegime = 0;

   if(newRegime != g_goldRegime)
   {
      string names[] = {"BEAR", "TRANSITION", "BULL"};
      Print(StringFormat("[SMC-Gold] Régime W1 changé : %s ? %s | EMA50=%.2f EMA200=%.2f",
            names[g_goldRegime+1], names[newRegime+1], ema50, ema200));
   }
   g_goldRegime       = newRegime;
   g_goldRegimeUpdate = TimeCurrent();
   return g_goldRegime;
}

bool SMC_IsGoldDirectionAllowed(const string direction)
{
   if(!SMC_IsGoldProfileActive()) return true;
   int regime = SMC_GetGoldRegimeW1();
   if(regime ==  1) return (direction == "BUY");
   if(regime == -1) return true;
   return true;
}

double SMC_GoldTransitionLotFactor()
{
   if(!SMC_IsGoldProfileActive() || !GoldUseRegimeFilter) return 1.0;
   return (SMC_GetGoldRegimeW1() == 0) ? 0.5 : 1.0;
}

void SMC_ManageGoldPartialTP()
{
   if(!SMC_IsGoldProfileActive() || !GoldUsePartialTP) return;
   if(g_goldPartialTicket == 0) return;
   if(!posInfo.SelectByTicket(g_goldPartialTicket)) { g_goldPartialTicket = 0; return; }
   if(posInfo.Symbol() != _Symbol || posInfo.Magic() != InpMagicNumber) { g_goldPartialTicket = 0; return; }

   double curPrice = posInfo.PriceCurrent();
   double ep       = g_goldEntryPrice;
   double slDist   = g_goldSlDistance;
   if(slDist <= 0) return;

   bool isBuy = (posInfo.PositionType() == POSITION_TYPE_BUY);

   if(!g_goldHalfClosed)
   {
      double tp1dist = slDist * GoldTP_ATRMult / SMC_EffectiveSLMult();
      bool tp1Hit = isBuy ? (curPrice >= ep + slDist * 1.5) : (curPrice <= ep - slDist * 1.5);

      if(tp1Hit)
      {
         double halfLot = posInfo.Volume() * 0.5;
         double minLot  = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_VOLUME_MIN);
         double stepLot = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_VOLUME_STEP);
         halfLot = MathMax(minLot, MathFloor(halfLot / stepLot) * stepLot);

         if(halfLot >= minLot && trade.PositionClosePartial(g_goldPartialTicket, halfLot))
         {
            g_goldHalfClosed = true;
            int    dg      = (int)SymbolInfoInteger(_Symbol, SYMBOL_DIGITS);
            double newSL   = NormalizeDouble(ep, dg);
            double minStop = (double)SymbolInfoInteger(_Symbol, SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL) * _Point;
            bool   slOk    = isBuy ? (newSL < curPrice - minStop) : (newSL > curPrice + minStop);
            if(slOk)
            {
               double currentSL = posInfo.StopLoss();
               newSL = NormalizeSLForBroker(_Symbol, newSL, currentSL);
               trade.PositionModify(g_goldPartialTicket, newSL, posInfo.TakeProfit());
            }
            Print(StringFormat("[SMC-Gold] TP1 PARTIEL Or | %.2f lots fermés à RR=1.5 | SL?BE (%.2f)",
                  halfLot, ep));
         }
      }
   }
}

void SMC_ManageGoldScalp()
{
   if(!GoldScalpEnabled) return;
   if(!SMC_IsGoldProfileActive()) return;
   if(BlockAllTrades) return;

   string cogDir = g_cogDirection;
   int    gomVn  = g_smcGomVerdictNum;

   bool cogTurnedOff  = (cogDir != "BUY");
   bool gomWait       = (gomVn == 0);

   if(cogTurnedOff || gomWait)
   {
      if(g_goldScalpCogPrev == "BUY" && cogTurnedOff)
      {
         Print("[GOLD-SCALP] COG changé (", cogDir, ") — fermeture de tous les scalps Or");
         for(int i = PositionsTotal() - 1; i >= 0; i--)
         {
            if(!posInfo.SelectByIndex(i)) continue;
            if(posInfo.Symbol() != _Symbol)     continue;
            if(posInfo.Magic()  != InpMagicNumber) continue;
            if(StringFind(posInfo.Comment(), "GOLD_SCALP") < 0) continue;
            PositionCloseWithLog(posInfo.Ticket(), "COG changé — sortie scalp Or");
         }
      }
      else if(gomWait && g_goldScalpCogPrev == "BUY")
      {
         Print("[GOLD-SCALP] GOM=WAIT — fermeture scalps Or");
         for(int i = PositionsTotal() - 1; i >= 0; i--)
         {
            if(!posInfo.SelectByIndex(i)) continue;
            if(posInfo.Symbol() != _Symbol)        continue;
            if(posInfo.Magic()  != InpMagicNumber) continue;
            if(StringFind(posInfo.Comment(), "GOLD_SCALP") < 0) continue;
            PositionCloseWithLog(posInfo.Ticket(), "GOM WAIT — sortie scalp Or");
         }
      }
      g_goldScalpCogPrev = cogDir;
      return;
   }

    // --- STRICT GOM GATE: Only GOOD/PERFECT (vn >= 2 or vn <= -2) ---
    if(!UseGOMVerdictFilter || !g_smcGomConnected) return;
    if(!SMCGP_IsGoodPerfect(gomVn))
    {
       static datetime lastScalpGomLog = 0;
       if(TimeCurrent() - lastScalpGomLog >= 30)
       { lastScalpGomLog = TimeCurrent();
         Print("[GOLD-SCALP] Bloqué — verdict=", g_smcGomVerdict, " vn=", gomVn); }
       return;
    }

    g_goldScalpCogPrev = "BUY";

    if(g_smcIAStatusAction != "BUY")
   {
      static datetime s_iaGoldLog = 0;
      if(TimeCurrent() - s_iaGoldLog >= 120)
      { s_iaGoldLog = TimeCurrent();
        Print("[GOLD-SCALP] IA Status=", g_smcIAStatusAction, " — scalp bloqué"); }
      return;
   }

   if(!g_smcCorrEntrySafe && g_smcCorrExhaustPct < 65.0)
   {
      static datetime s_corrGoldLog = 0;
      if(TimeCurrent() - s_corrGoldLog >= 120)
      { s_corrGoldLog = TimeCurrent();
        Print("[GOLD-SCALP] Correction active (", g_smcCorrPhase, " ",
              DoubleToString(g_smcCorrExhaustPct, 0), "%) — scalp bloqué"); }
      return;
   }

   if(TimeCurrent() - g_goldScalpLastEntry < GoldScalpCooldownSec) return;

   int scalpCount = 0;
   for(int i = PositionsTotal() - 1; i >= 0; i--)
   {
      if(!posInfo.SelectByIndex(i)) continue;
      if(posInfo.Symbol() != _Symbol)        continue;
      if(posInfo.Magic()  != InpMagicNumber) continue;
      if(StringFind(posInfo.Comment(), "GOLD_SCALP") >= 0) scalpCount++;
   }
   if(scalpCount >= GoldScalpMaxPositions) return;
   if(SMC_TerminalPositionCapReached()) return;

   double atr = GOM_GetATRValue();
   if(atr <= 0) return;
   double ask = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK);
   if(ask <= 0) return;

   bool trigger = false;
   string reason = "";

   if(GoldScalpUseEMA9 && g_goldScalpEma9M1 != INVALID_HANDLE)
   {
      double ema9[];
      ArraySetAsSeries(ema9, true);
      if(CopyBuffer(g_goldScalpEma9M1, 0, 0, 3, ema9) == 3)
      {
         double low1[];
         ArraySetAsSeries(low1, true);
         if(CopyLow(_Symbol, PERIOD_M1, 0, 3, low1) == 3)
         {
            bool touchedEma = (low1[1] <= ema9[1] + atr * 0.1);
            bool recovering = (ask > ema9[0]);
            if(touchedEma && recovering)
            {
               trigger = true;
               reason  = "EMA9_REBOND";
            }
         }
      }
   }

   if(!trigger && GoldScalpUseOBBull)
   {
      MqlRates rates[];
      ArraySetAsSeries(rates, true);
      if(CopyRates(_Symbol, PERIOD_M1, 0, 30, rates) == 30)
      {
         double tol = atr * GoldScalpOBTolATR;
         for(int k = 2; k < 28 && !trigger; k++)
         {
            bool isBullOB = (rates[k].close < rates[k].open &&
                             rates[k+1].close > rates[k+1].open &&
                             (rates[k+1].high - rates[k].low) > SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_POINT) * 10);
            if(!isBullOB) continue;
            double obHigh = rates[k].high;
            double obLow  = rates[k].low;
            if(ask >= obLow - tol && ask <= obHigh + tol)
            {
               trigger = true;
               reason  = StringFormat("OB_BULL@%.2f-%.2f", obLow, obHigh);
            }
         }
      }
   }

   if(!trigger) return;

   double sl = ask - atr * GoldScalpSL_ATRMult;
   double tp = ask + atr * GoldScalpTP_ATRMult;

   double balance   = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE);
   double riskAmt   = balance * GoldScalpRiskPct / 100.0;
   double slPips    = atr * GoldScalpSL_ATRMult;
   double tickVal   = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_VALUE);
   double tickSize  = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_SIZE);
   double minLot    = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_VOLUME_MIN);
   double lotStep   = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_VOLUME_STEP);
   double maxLot    = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_VOLUME_MAX);
   double lot = 0.01;
   if(tickVal > 0 && tickSize > 0 && slPips > 0)
      lot = riskAmt / (slPips / tickSize * tickVal);
   lot = MathMax(minLot, MathFloor(lot / lotStep) * lotStep);
   lot = MathMin(lot, maxLot);

   MqlTradeRequest req = {};
   MqlTradeResult  res = {};
   req.action    = TRADE_ACTION_DEAL;
   req.symbol    = _Symbol;
   req.volume    = lot;
   req.type      = ORDER_TYPE_BUY;
   req.price     = ask;
   req.sl        = NormalizeDouble(sl, _Digits);
   req.tp        = NormalizeDouble(tp, _Digits);
   req.deviation = 10;
   req.magic     = InpMagicNumber;
   req.comment   = "GOLD_SCALP|" + reason;
   {
      long fillFlags = SymbolInfoInteger(_Symbol, SYMBOL_FILLING_MODE);
      if((fillFlags & SYMBOL_FILLING_IOC) != 0)
         req.type_filling = ORDER_FILLING_IOC;
      else if((fillFlags & SYMBOL_FILLING_FOK) != 0)
         req.type_filling = ORDER_FILLING_FOK;
      else
         req.type_filling = ORDER_FILLING_RETURN;
   }

   // Dernière barrière avant envoi : aucune exposition opposée ni pending inverse.
   if(!CanTradeOnSymbol(_Symbol, "BUY"))
   {
      Print("[GOLD-SCALP] BUY bloqué par le gate anti-hedge/sniper sur ", _Symbol);
      return;
   }

   g_goldScalpLastEntry = TimeCurrent();

   if(SafeOrderSendAndAlert(req, res) && res.retcode == TRADE_RETCODE_DONE)
   {
      Print(StringFormat("[GOLD-SCALP] BUY %.2f lots @ %.2f | SL=%.2f TP=%.2f | %s | COG=%s GOM=%s",
            lot, ask, sl, tp, reason, cogDir, g_smcGomVerdict));
   }
   else
   {
      Print(StringFormat("[GOLD-SCALP] Échec BUY retcode=%d | %s — cooldown %ds avant prochain essai",
            res.retcode, reason, GoldScalpCooldownSec));
   }
}
