// ==========================================================================
// === PROACTIVE ENTRY ZONE CACHING (FVG / OB / Swing / ATR)              ===
// ==========================================================================
// Zones calculées AVANT spike — le spike arrive → on place l'ordre au prix de la zone
// g_cachedBestBuyLevel / g_cachedBestSellLevel : SMC_SharedCore.mqh
string   g_cachedBuySource      = "";
string   g_cachedSellSource     = "";
datetime g_cachedZoneUpdate     = 0;
#define ZONE_CACHE_TTL_SEC  5   // Recalculer les zones toutes les 5 secondes

void UpdateCachedEntryZones()
{
   if(TimeCurrent() - g_cachedZoneUpdate < ZONE_CACHE_TTL_SEC) return;
   g_cachedZoneUpdate = TimeCurrent();

   double atr = 0.0;
   if(atrHandle != INVALID_HANDLE)
   {
      double atrBuf[];
      ArraySetAsSeries(atrBuf, true);
      if(CopyBuffer(atrHandle, 0, 0, 1, atrBuf) >= 1) atr = atrBuf[0];
   }
   if(atr <= 0) return;

   double bid = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);
   double ask = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK);
   if(bid <= 0 || ask <= 0) return;

   // --- BUY zones: Swing low (plus proche support) ---
   string srcBuy = "";
   double swingBuy = GetClosestBuyLevel(bid, atr, 2.0, srcBuy);
   if(swingBuy > 0 && swingBuy < bid && (bid - swingBuy) <= atr * 2.5)
   {
      g_cachedBestBuyLevel = swingBuy;
      g_cachedBuySource    = "SWING_" + srcBuy;
   }
   else
   {
      g_cachedBestBuyLevel = bid - atr * 1.5;
      g_cachedBuySource    = "ATR";
   }

   // --- SELL zones: Swing high (plus proche résistance) ---
   string srcSell = "";
   double swingSell = GetClosestSellLevel(ask, atr, 2.0, srcSell);
   if(swingSell > 0 && swingSell > ask && (swingSell - ask) <= atr * 2.5)
   {
      g_cachedBestSellLevel = swingSell;
      g_cachedSellSource    = "SWING_" + srcSell;
   }
   else
   {
      g_cachedBestSellLevel = ask + atr * 1.5;
      g_cachedSellSource    = "ATR";
   }
}

void DrawCachedEntryZones()
{
   if(!ShowChartGraphics) return;

   double atr = 0.0;
   if(atrHandle != INVALID_HANDLE)
   {
      double atrBuf[];
      ArraySetAsSeries(atrBuf, true);
      if(CopyBuffer(atrHandle, 0, 0, 1, atrBuf) >= 1) atr = atrBuf[0];
   }
   if(atr <= 0) return;

   datetime now = TimeCurrent();
   int barSec = PeriodSeconds();

   // Zone BUY
   if(g_cachedBestBuyLevel > 0)
   {
      string name = "SMC_CachedBuyZone";
      double upper = g_cachedBestBuyLevel + atr * 0.1;
      double lower = g_cachedBestBuyLevel - atr * 0.1;
      ObjectCreate(0, name, OBJ_RECTANGLE, 0, now - barSec * 20, lower, now + barSec * 50, upper);
      ObjectSetInteger(0, name, OBJPROP_COLOR, clrDodgerBlue);
      ObjectSetInteger(0, name, OBJPROP_FILL, true);
      ObjectSetInteger(0, name, OBJPROP_BACK, true);
      ObjectSetInteger(0, name, OBJPROP_WIDTH, 1);
      ObjectSetString(0, name, OBJPROP_TEXT, "BUY zone [" + g_cachedBuySource + "]");
   }

   // Zone SELL
   if(g_cachedBestSellLevel > 0)
   {
      string name = "SMC_CachedSellZone";
      double upper = g_cachedBestSellLevel + atr * 0.1;
      double lower = g_cachedBestSellLevel - atr * 0.1;
      ObjectCreate(0, name, OBJ_RECTANGLE, 0, now - barSec * 20, lower, now + barSec * 50, upper);
      ObjectSetInteger(0, name, OBJPROP_COLOR, clrCrimson);
      ObjectSetInteger(0, name, OBJPROP_FILL, true);
      ObjectSetInteger(0, name, OBJPROP_BACK, true);
      ObjectSetInteger(0, name, OBJPROP_WIDTH, 1);
      ObjectSetString(0, name, OBJPROP_TEXT, "SELL zone [" + g_cachedSellSource + "]");
   }
}

//| GESTION DES POSITIONS ET VARIABLES GLOBALES                    |

// Vrai si ce symbole a subi une perte récente (SL ou autre) → réentrée soumise à conditions strictes
bool IsRecentLossOnSymbol(const string symbol)
{
   if(g_lastLossSymbol == "" || symbol == "") return false;
   if(g_lastLossSymbol != symbol) return false;
   return (TimeCurrent() - g_lastLossTime <= LossCooldownMinutes * 60);
}

// Vrai si ce symbole a eu un gain récent → réentrée soumise à cooldown (demande Sidoine)
bool IsRecentGainOnSymbol(const string symbol)
{
   if(!UseGainCooldown) return false;
   if(g_lastGainSymbol == "" || symbol == "")
   {
      static datetime s_debugLog = 0;
      if(TimeCurrent() - s_debugLog >= 60)
      {
         Print("[GAIN-COOLDOWN-DEBUG] g_lastGainSymbol='", g_lastGainSymbol, "' symbol='", symbol, "' UseGainCooldown=", UseGainCooldown);
         s_debugLog = TimeCurrent();
      }
      return false;
   }
   if(g_lastGainSymbol != symbol)
   {
      static datetime s_debugLog2 = 0;
      if(TimeCurrent() - s_debugLog2 >= 60)
      {
         Print("[GAIN-COOLDOWN-DEBUG] Symbole différent: g_lastGainSymbol='", g_lastGainSymbol, "' vs symbol='", symbol, "'");
         s_debugLog2 = TimeCurrent();
      }
      return false;
   }

   int elapsed = (int)(TimeCurrent() - g_lastGainTime);
   int cooldownSec = GainCooldownMinutes * 60;
   bool inCooldown = (elapsed <= cooldownSec);

   static datetime s_debugLog3 = 0;
   if(TimeCurrent() - s_debugLog3 >= 30)
   {
      Print("[GAIN-COOLDOWN-DEBUG] ", symbol, " | Écoulé: ", elapsed, "s | Cooldown: ", cooldownSec, "s | En cooldown: ", inCooldown);
      s_debugLog3 = TimeCurrent();
   }

   return inCooldown;
}

// Autorise ou bloque une réentrée après perte récente sur ce symbole.
// spikeImminent: vrai si le contexte actuel indique un spike / setup exceptionnel (déjà calculé par l'appelant).
bool AllowReentryAfterRecentLoss(const string symbol, const string direction, bool spikeImminent)
{
   // Mode patient après 2 pertes: bloquer TOUT signal normal
   if(SMC_DoubleLossPatientBlocks(symbol))
   {
      Print("🚫 Réentrée PATIENT FVG — ", symbol,
            " | ", g_symConsecLosses, " pertes — attendre FVG_TRAIL react ou spike GOM_TF_TL_M5");
      return false;
   }

   if(!IsRecentLossOnSymbol(symbol)) return true;

   string dir = direction;
   StringToUpper(dir);

   double conf = g_lastAIConfidence;
   bool iaStrong = (conf >= 0.90) &&
                   (g_lastAIAction == "BUY" || g_lastAIAction == "buy" ||
                    g_lastAIAction == "SELL" || g_lastAIAction == "sell");

   if(!spikeImminent)
   {
      double p = CalculateSpikeProbability();
      spikeImminent = (p >= 0.80);
   }

   if(iaStrong && spikeImminent)
   {
      Print("✅ Réentrée après perte autorisée sur ", symbol,
            " - conf IA ", DoubleToString(conf*100, 1), "% + spike fort");
      return true;
   }

   Print("🚫 Réentrée après perte sur ", symbol, " bloquée");
   return false;
}

void SMC_RecordSymbolTradeResult(const string symbol, const double profit)
{
   if(symbol == "") return;
   if(profit < 0.0)
   {
      if(g_symLossSymbol == symbol)
         g_symConsecLosses++;
      else
      {
         g_symLossSymbol   = symbol;
         g_symConsecLosses = 1;
      }
      g_symLastLossTime = TimeCurrent();
      Print("📉 Perte #", g_symConsecLosses, " sur ", symbol,
            (g_symConsecLosses >= DoubleLossThreshold ? " → MODE PATIENT FVG TRAIL armé" : ""),
            (g_symConsecLosses >= g_lossRecoverMinLosses ? " → MODE LOSS RECOVER armé" : ""));
      if(UseDoubleLossFVGTrail && g_symConsecLosses >= DoubleLossThreshold)
         SMC_ArmFVGTrailPatient(symbol);
      // FIX v1.30: Activer Loss Recover après 2 pertes pour autoriser BUY sur PainX/SELL sur GainX
      if(g_symConsecLosses >= g_lossRecoverMinLosses)
      {
         g_lossRecoverArmed = true;
         g_lossRecoverSymbol = symbol;
         g_lossRecoverSince = TimeCurrent();
         Print("🔄 LOSS RECOVER ACTIVÉ sur ", symbol, " - BUY sur PainX/SELL sur GainX autorisés");
      }
   }
   else if(g_symLossSymbol == symbol)
   {
      if(g_fvgTrailPatientArmed)
         SMC_DisarmFVGTrailPatient("gain sur " + symbol);
      // FIX v1.30: Désactiver Loss Recover après gain
      if(g_lossRecoverArmed)
      {
         g_lossRecoverArmed = false;
         g_lossRecoverSymbol = "";
         g_lossRecoverSince = 0;
         Print("✅ LOSS RECOVER DÉSACTIVÉ sur ", symbol, " - gain détecté");
      }
      g_symLossSymbol   = "";
      g_symConsecLosses = 0;
      g_symLastLossTime = 0;
   }
}

bool SMC_DoubleLossPatientBlocks(const string symbol)
{
   if(!UseDoubleLossFVGTrail) return false;
   if(!g_fvgTrailPatientArmed) return false;
   if(g_symLossSymbol != symbol) return false;
   if(g_symConsecLosses < DoubleLossThreshold) return false;
   if(g_fvgTrailPatientSince > 0 &&
      (TimeCurrent() - g_fvgTrailPatientSince) > FVGTrailPatientMaxMin * 60)
   {
      SMC_DisarmFVGTrailPatient("timeout patient");
      return false;
   }
   int native = 0;
   if(IsBoomLikeSymbol(symbol)) native = 1;
   else if(IsCrashLikeSymbol(symbol)) native = -1;
   if(native != 0 && SMCGP_SpikeFireAllowed(symbol, native))
      return false;
   return true;
}

// FIX v1.30: Vérification des conditions strictes pour Loss Recover
// Conditions requises:
// - GOM PERFECT (|vn| >= 2)
// - Au moins 3 timeframes alignés (M1, M5, M15, H1)
// - Prix loin des résistances/20-bar/pivots (BUY: loin résistances, SELL: loin supports)
bool SMC_LossRecoverConditionsOK(const string symbol, const int dirSign)
{
   if(!g_lossRecoverArmed || g_lossRecoverSymbol != symbol)
      return false;

   // 1) Vérifier timeout Loss Recover
   if(g_lossRecoverSince > 0 &&
      (TimeCurrent() - g_lossRecoverSince) > g_lossRecoverMaxMin * 60)
   {
      g_lossRecoverArmed = false;
      g_lossRecoverSymbol = "";
      g_lossRecoverSince = 0;
      Print("⏱️ LOSS RECOVER TIMEOUT - désactivé sur ", symbol);
      return false;
   }

   // 2) Vérifier GOM GOOD/PERFECT requis
   int vnRec = g_smcGomVerdictNum;
   if(MathAbs(vnRec) < 2) vnRec = g_smcGomVerdictNumServer;
   if(MathAbs(vnRec) < 2)
   {
      Print("❌ LOSS RECOVER - GOM pas GOOD/PERFECT (vn=", g_smcGomVerdictNum, ")");
      return false;
   }

   // 3) Vérifier alignement direction GOM
   if((dirSign > 0 && vnRec <= 0) ||
      (dirSign < 0 && vnRec >= 0))
   {
      Print("❌ LOSS RECOVER - GOM oppose à direction");
      return false;
   }

   // 4) Vérifier alignement minimum 3 timeframes
   string m1Dir = (StringLen(g_smcTfM1DirLive) > 0) ? g_smcTfM1DirLive : g_smcTfM1Dir;
   string m5Dir = g_smcTfM5Dir;
   string m15Dir = g_smcTfM15Dir;
   string h1Dir = g_smcTfH1Dir;

   int alignedCount = 0;
   if(SMC_TfDirMatchesSign(dirSign, m1Dir)) alignedCount++;
   if(SMC_TfDirMatchesSign(dirSign, m5Dir)) alignedCount++;
   if(SMC_TfDirMatchesSign(dirSign, m15Dir)) alignedCount++;
   if(SMC_TfDirMatchesSign(dirSign, h1Dir)) alignedCount++;

   if(alignedCount < 3)
   {
      Print("❌ LOSS RECOVER - Timeframes alignés: ", alignedCount, "/4 (min 3 requis)");
      return false;
   }

   // 5) Vérifier distance par rapport aux résistances/ supports/ pivots
   double currentPrice = SymbolInfoDouble(symbol, SYMBOL_BID);
   double atr = 0.0;
   if(atrHandle != INVALID_HANDLE)
   {
      double ab[];
      ArraySetAsSeries(ab, true);
      if(CopyBuffer(atrHandle, 0, 0, 1, ab) >= 1)
         atr = ab[0];
   }
   if(atr <= 0.0)
      atr = SymbolInfoDouble(symbol, SYMBOL_POINT) * 50.0;
   double minDist = atr * 0.5; // Distance minimum: 0.5 ATR

   // Pour BUY: vérifier distance aux résistances (20-bar, pivot high)
   if(dirSign > 0)
   {
      double resistance20 = GetResistanceLevel(20);
      if(resistance20 > 0 && (resistance20 - currentPrice) < minDist)
      {
         Print("❌ LOSS RECOVER - Trop proche résistance 20-bar (dist=",
               DoubleToString(resistance20 - currentPrice, 2), ")");
         return false;
      }

      // Vérifier pivot high proche
      MqlRates rates[];
      ArraySetAsSeries(rates, true);
      if(CopyRates(symbol, PERIOD_M5, 0, 25, rates) >= 20)
      {
         for(int i = 2; i < 18; i++)
         {
            if(rates[i].high > rates[i-1].high && rates[i].high > rates[i+1].high &&
               rates[i].high > rates[i-2].high && rates[i].high > rates[i+2].high)
            {
               if((rates[i].high - currentPrice) < minDist)
               {
                  Print("❌ LOSS RECOVER - Trop proche pivot high (dist=",
                        DoubleToString(rates[i].high - currentPrice, 2), ")");
                  return false;
               }
            }
         }
      }
   }
   // Pour SELL: vérifier distance aux supports (20-bar, pivot low)
   else if(dirSign < 0)
   {
      double support20 = GetSupportLevel(20);
      if(support20 > 0 && (currentPrice - support20) < minDist)
      {
         Print("❌ LOSS RECOVER - Trop proche support 20-bar (dist=",
               DoubleToString(currentPrice - support20, 2), ")");
         return false;
      }

      // Vérifier pivot low proche
      MqlRates rates[];
      ArraySetAsSeries(rates, true);
      if(CopyRates(symbol, PERIOD_M5, 0, 25, rates) >= 20)
      {
         for(int i = 2; i < 18; i++)
         {
            if(rates[i].low < rates[i-1].low && rates[i].low < rates[i+1].low &&
               rates[i].low < rates[i-2].low && rates[i].low < rates[i+2].low)
            {
               if((currentPrice - rates[i].low) < minDist)
               {
                  Print("❌ LOSS RECOVER - Trop proche pivot low (dist=",
                        DoubleToString(currentPrice - rates[i].low, 2), ")");
                  return false;
               }
            }
         }
      }
   }

   Print("✅ LOSS RECOVER - Conditions OK sur ", symbol,
         " | TF alignés: ", alignedCount, "/4 | GOM PERFECT | Distance OK");
   return true;
}

void SMC_ArmFVGTrailPatient(const string symbol)
{
   g_fvgTrailPatientArmed  = true;
   g_fvgTrailPatientSince  = TimeCurrent();
   g_fvgTrailTouched       = false;
   g_fvgTrailTouchDir      = 0;
   g_fvgTrailTouchTime     = 0;
   Print("⏳ MODE PATIENT FVG TRAIL armé sur ", symbol,
         " | pertes=", g_symConsecLosses,
         " | FVG react OU (si cassure) spike GOM_TF_TL_M5 uniquement");
}

void SMC_DisarmFVGTrailPatient(const string reason)
{
   if(!g_fvgTrailPatientArmed) return;
   Print("✅ MODE PATIENT FVG TRAIL désarmé — ", reason);
   g_fvgTrailPatientArmed = false;
   g_fvgTrailPatientSince = 0;
   g_fvgTrailTouched      = false;
   g_fvgTrailTouchDir     = 0;
   g_fvgTrailTouchTime    = 0;
}

bool SMC_GetNearestFVGTrail(const int dirSign, double &midOut, double &botOut, double &topOut)
{
   midOut = 0; botOut = 0; topOut = 0;
   double bid = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);
   if(bid <= 0) return false;
   if(dirSign > 0 && g_fvgTrailBullMid > 0)
   {
      midOut = g_fvgTrailBullMid; botOut = g_fvgTrailBullBot; topOut = g_fvgTrailBullTop;
      return true;
   }
   if(dirSign < 0 && g_fvgTrailBearMid > 0)
   {
      midOut = g_fvgTrailBearMid; botOut = g_fvgTrailBearBot; topOut = g_fvgTrailBearTop;
      return true;
   }
   double bestDist = 1e100;
   string prefix = (dirSign > 0) ? "SMC_DISP_FVG_TRAIL_Bull_" : "SMC_DISP_FVG_TRAIL_Bear_";
   int total = ObjectsTotal(0, 0, -1);
   for(int i = 0; i < total; i++)
   {
      string name = ObjectName(0, i, 0, -1);
      if(StringFind(name, prefix) != 0) continue;
      double p1 = ObjectGetDouble(0, name, OBJPROP_PRICE, 0);
      if(p1 <= 0) continue;
      double d = MathAbs(bid - p1);
      if(d < bestDist) { bestDist = d; midOut = p1; botOut = p1; topOut = p1; }
   }
   return (midOut > 0);
}

void SMC_ManageDoubleLossFVGTrailEntry()
{
   if(!UseDoubleLossFVGTrail) return;
   if(!g_fvgTrailPatientArmed) return;
   if(g_symLossSymbol != _Symbol) return;
   if(BlockAllTrades) return;

   // FIX v1.34: BLOQUER si verdict est WAIT
   if(g_smcGomVerdictNum == 0) return;

   if(g_fvgTrailPatientSince > 0 &&
      (TimeCurrent() - g_fvgTrailPatientSince) > FVGTrailPatientMaxMin * 60)
   {
      SMC_DisarmFVGTrailPatient("timeout " + IntegerToString(FVGTrailPatientMaxMin) + " min");
      return;
   }
   if(g_fvgTrailLastEntryTime > 0 &&
      (TimeCurrent() - g_fvgTrailLastEntryTime) < FVGTrailEntryCooldownSec)
      return;
   if(CountPositionsForSymbol(_Symbol) > 0) return;

   bool isBoom  = IsBoomLikeSymbol(_Symbol);
   bool isCrash = IsCrashLikeSymbol(_Symbol);
   int  dirSign = 0;
   if(isBoom)  dirSign = 1;
   else if(isCrash) dirSign = -1;
   else if(g_smcGomConnected && MathAbs(g_smcGomVerdictNum) >= MinGOMVerdictNumAbs)
      dirSign = (g_smcGomVerdictNum > 0) ? 1 : -1;
   if(dirSign == 0) return;

   if(FVGTrailRequireGOMGood)
   {
      if(!g_smcGomConnected || MathAbs(g_smcGomVerdictNum) < MinGOMVerdictNumAbs)
         return;
      if((dirSign > 0 && g_smcGomVerdictNum < 0) || (dirSign < 0 && g_smcGomVerdictNum > 0))
         return;
   }

   double atrVal = 0;
   if(atrHandle != INVALID_HANDLE)
   {
      double ab[];
      ArraySetAsSeries(ab, true);
      if(CopyBuffer(atrHandle, 0, 0, 1, ab) >= 1) atrVal = ab[0];
   }
   if(atrVal <= 0) atrVal = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_POINT) * 50.0;

   double mid = 0, bot = 0, top = 0;
   if(!SMC_GetNearestFVGTrail(dirSign, mid, bot, top))
      return;

   double bid = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);
   double ask = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK);
   double px  = (bid + ask) * 0.5;
   double touchDist = atrVal * FVGTrailTouchATRMult;
   double reactDist = atrVal * FVGTrailReactATRMult;

   bool inZone = false;
   if(bot > 0 && top > bot)
      inZone = (px >= bot - touchDist && px <= top + touchDist);
   else
      inZone = (MathAbs(px - mid) <= touchDist);

   // Cassure FVG sans réaction = forte correction → aucune initiative
   static bool s_fvgBrokenNoReact = false;
   static datetime s_fvgBrokenTime = 0;

   bool brokenDown = false, brokenUp = false;
   if(dirSign > 0)
      brokenDown = (px < ((bot > 0) ? bot : mid) - touchDist);
   else
      brokenUp = (px > ((top > 0) ? top : mid) + touchDist);

   if((brokenDown || brokenUp) && !g_fvgTrailTouched)
   {
      if(!s_fvgBrokenNoReact)
      {
         s_fvgBrokenNoReact = true;
         s_fvgBrokenTime = TimeCurrent();
         Print("⛔ FVG TRAIL CASSÉ sans réaction — ", _Symbol,
               " | forte correction | AUCUNE entrée | observer spike GOM_TF_TL_M5");
      }
   }
   else if(inZone)
      s_fvgBrokenNoReact = false;

   if(inZone && !g_fvgTrailTouched && !s_fvgBrokenNoReact)
   {
      g_fvgTrailTouched = true;
      g_fvgTrailTouchDir = dirSign;
      g_fvgTrailTouchTime = TimeCurrent();
      Print("📍 FVG TRAIL TOUCHÉ — ", _Symbol, " | mid=", DoubleToString(mid, _Digits),
            " | attendre réaction (sinon → GOM_TF_TL_M5)");
      return;
   }

   if(g_fvgTrailTouched && g_fvgTrailTouchTime > 0 &&
      (TimeCurrent() - g_fvgTrailTouchTime) > 120)
   {
      if(!inZone)
      {
         s_fvgBrokenNoReact = true;
         s_fvgBrokenTime = TimeCurrent();
         Print("⛔ FVG TRAIL touch sans réaction — correction | observer GOM_TF_TL_M5");
      }
      g_fvgTrailTouched = false;
      g_fvgTrailTouchDir = 0;
      g_fvgTrailTouchTime = 0;
   }

   bool fvgReacted = false;
   if(g_fvgTrailTouched && g_fvgTrailTouchDir == dirSign && !s_fvgBrokenNoReact)
   {
      MqlRates r[];
      ArraySetAsSeries(r, true);
      if(CopyRates(_Symbol, PERIOD_M1, 0, 3, r) >= 2)
      {
         if(dirSign > 0)
            fvgReacted = (px >= mid + reactDist) || (r[0].close > r[0].open && r[0].close > mid) ||
                         ((bot > 0) ? (px > top) : (px > mid + reactDist * 0.5));
         else
            fvgReacted = (px <= mid - reactDist) || (r[0].close < r[0].open && r[0].close < mid) ||
                         ((top > 0) ? (px < bot) : (px < mid - reactDist * 0.5));
      }
   }

   // Spike réaction sur GOM_TF_TL_M5 (surtout après cassure)
   bool m5TlSpikeReact = false;
   double m5TlLevel = 0.0;
   string tlNames[6];
   tlNames[0] = "GOM_TF_TL_M5";
   tlNames[1] = "GOM_TF_TL_M5_" + _Symbol;
   tlNames[2] = "GOM_TL_M5";
   tlNames[3] = "TF_TL_M5";
   tlNames[4] = "GOM_TF_TL_M5_SUP";
   tlNames[5] = "GOM_TF_TL_M5_RES";
   for(int ti = 0; ti < 6; ti++)
   {
      if(ObjectFind(0, tlNames[ti]) < 0) continue;
      double p0 = ObjectGetDouble(0, tlNames[ti], OBJPROP_PRICE, 0);
      double p1 = ObjectGetDouble(0, tlNames[ti], OBJPROP_PRICE, 1);
      if(p0 > 0) { m5TlLevel = p0; break; }
      if(p1 > 0) { m5TlLevel = p1; break; }
   }
   if(m5TlLevel <= 0)
   {
      int total = ObjectsTotal(0, 0, -1);
      for(int i = 0; i < total; i++)
      {
         string name = ObjectName(0, i, 0, -1);
         if(StringFind(name, "GOM_TF_TL_M5") < 0 && StringFind(name, "TF_TL_M5") < 0) continue;
         double p0 = ObjectGetDouble(0, name, OBJPROP_PRICE, 0);
         if(p0 > 0) { m5TlLevel = p0; break; }
      }
   }
   if(m5TlLevel <= 0)
   {
      int emaH = iMA(_Symbol, PERIOD_M5, 21, 0, MODE_EMA, PRICE_CLOSE);
      if(emaH != INVALID_HANDLE)
      {
         double eb[];
         ArraySetAsSeries(eb, true);
         if(CopyBuffer(emaH, 0, 0, 1, eb) >= 1) m5TlLevel = eb[0];
      }
   }

   if(m5TlLevel > 0)
   {
      bool nearTL = (MathAbs(px - m5TlLevel) <= atrVal * 0.35);
      MqlRates m1r[], m5r[];
      ArraySetAsSeries(m1r, true);
      ArraySetAsSeries(m5r, true);
      bool spikeBar = false;
      if(CopyRates(_Symbol, PERIOD_M1, 0, 5, m1r) >= 3)
      {
         double body = MathAbs(m1r[0].close - m1r[0].open);
         double rng  = m1r[0].high - m1r[0].low;
         double avgBody = 0;
         for(int k = 1; k < 4; k++) avgBody += MathAbs(m1r[k].close - m1r[k].open);
         avgBody /= 3.0;
         bool bigBody = (avgBody > 0 && body >= avgBody * 1.6) || (rng >= atrVal * 0.8);
         bool dirOk = (dirSign > 0 && m1r[0].close > m1r[0].open) ||
                      (dirSign < 0 && m1r[0].close < m1r[0].open);
         spikeBar = bigBody && dirOk;
      }
      bool rejectTL = false;
      if(nearTL && CopyRates(_Symbol, PERIOD_M5, 0, 3, m5r) >= 2)
      {
         if(dirSign > 0)
            rejectTL = (m5r[0].low <= m5TlLevel + atrVal * 0.15) &&
                       (m5r[0].close > m5TlLevel) && (m5r[0].close > m5r[0].open);
         else
            rejectTL = (m5r[0].high >= m5TlLevel - atrVal * 0.15) &&
                       (m5r[0].close < m5TlLevel) && (m5r[0].close < m5r[0].open);
      }
      m5TlSpikeReact = nearTL && (spikeBar || rejectTL);
      if(s_fvgBrokenNoReact && m5TlSpikeReact)
         Print("⚡ SPIKE GOM_TF_TL_M5 — ", _Symbol, " | TL=", DoubleToString(m5TlLevel, _Digits),
               " | après cassure FVG → entrée 2e spike");
   }

   // A) FVG react  B) cassé + spike TL M5  C) sinon silence
   bool allowEntry = false;
   string entryWhy = "";
   if(fvgReacted)
   {
      allowEntry = true;
      entryWhy = "FVG-TRAIL react";
   }
   else if(m5TlSpikeReact && s_fvgBrokenNoReact)
   {
      allowEntry = true;
      entryWhy = "GOM_TF_TL_M5 spike";
      s_fvgBrokenNoReact = false;
   }
   else
      return;

   string direction = (dirSign > 0) ? "BUY" : "SELL";
   if(!IsDirectionAllowedForBoomCrash(_Symbol, direction)) return;
   if(!CanTradeOnSymbol(_Symbol, direction)) return;
   if(!CanPlaceMarketOrder(_Symbol, dirSign)) return;
   if(!TryAcquireOpenLock()) return;

   double lot = CalculateLotSize();
   if(lot <= 0) { ReleaseOpenLock(); return; }

   int dg = (int)SymbolInfoInteger(_Symbol, SYMBOL_DIGITS);
   double slDist = atrVal * MathMax(1.5, SL_ATRMult * 0.8);
   double tpDist = slDist * (UseSniperScalperMode ? MinRewardRiskRatio : 2.5);
   if(UseSniperScalperMode)
   {
      double tpAdj = tpDist;
      if(!SMC_ApplySniperRiskCap(_Symbol, slDist, lot, tpAdj))
      { ReleaseOpenLock(); return; }
      tpDist = tpAdj;
   }

   bool ok = false;
   string cmt = "FVG-TRAIL 2ndSPIKE " + entryWhy + " " + direction;
   if(dirSign > 0)
   {
      double sl = NormalizeDouble(ask - slDist, dg);
      double tp = NormalizeDouble(ask + tpDist, dg);
      if(!SMC_FinalOpenGate(_Symbol, ORDER_TYPE_BUY)) { ReleaseOpenLock(); return; }
      ok = SafeTradeBuy(lot, _Symbol, ask, sl, tp, cmt);
      if(ok) SMC_GateRegisterOpened(_Symbol, true);
   }
   else
   {
      double sl = NormalizeDouble(bid + slDist, dg);
      double tp = NormalizeDouble(bid - tpDist, dg);
      if(!SMC_FinalOpenGate(_Symbol, ORDER_TYPE_SELL)) { ReleaseOpenLock(); return; }
      ok = SafeTradeSell(lot, _Symbol, bid, sl, tp, cmt);
      if(ok) SMC_GateRegisterOpened(_Symbol, false);
   }

   if(ok)
   {
      RegisterOrderPlaced();
      g_fvgTrailLastEntryTime = TimeCurrent();
      ulong ticket = trade.ResultOrder();
      if(ticket > 0) SMC_ApplyPostEntrySLBuffer(_Symbol, ticket, 1.0);
      Print("🚀 ", cmt, " ", _Symbol,
            " @", DoubleToString(dirSign > 0 ? ask : bid, dg),
            " | FVG mid=", DoubleToString(mid, dg),
            " | M5 TL=", DoubleToString(m5TlLevel, dg),
            " | GOM vn=", g_smcGomVerdictNum);
      if(UseNotifications)
         SendNotification(cmt + " " + _Symbol);
      SMC_DisarmFVGTrailPatient("entrée 2e spike (" + entryWhy + ")");
      g_symConsecLosses = 0;
      g_symLossSymbol = "";
      s_fvgBrokenNoReact = false;
   }
   ReleaseOpenLock();
}

void SMC_TryLossRecoverNativeEntry()
{
   if(!g_lossRecoverArmed) return;
   if(g_lossRecoverSymbol != _Symbol) return;
   if(CountPositionsForSymbol(_Symbol) > 0) return;
   if(IsTerminalFull()) return;

   int dirSign = 0;
   if(IsBoomLikeSymbol(_Symbol)) dirSign = 1;
   else if(IsCrashLikeSymbol(_Symbol)) dirSign = -1;
   else return;

   if(g_lossRecoverSince > 0 &&
      (TimeCurrent() - g_lossRecoverSince) > g_lossRecoverMaxMin * 60)
   {
      g_lossRecoverArmed = false;
      g_lossRecoverSymbol = "";
      g_lossRecoverSince = 0;
      Print("⏱️ LOSS RECOVER TIMEOUT — ", _Symbol);
      return;
   }

   if(!SMCGP_SpikeFireAllowed(_Symbol, dirSign))
      return;

   static datetime s_lastRecov = 0;
   if(TimeCurrent() - s_lastRecov < 20) return;
   s_lastRecov = TimeCurrent();

   Print("🔄 LOSS RECOVER — relance native ", (dirSign > 0 ? "BUY" : "SELL"),
         " ", _Symbol, " | pertes=", g_symConsecLosses,
         " | GOM GOOD/PERFECT + M1/M5/M15");
   ExecuteSpikeTrade(dirSign > 0 ? "BUY" : "SELL");
}

// Lot minimal par défaut: 0.5 pour Boom 300 / Crash 300, sinon min du courtier
double GetMinLotForSymbol(const string symbol)
{
   if(StringFind(symbol, "Boom 300") >= 0 || StringFind(symbol, "Crash 300") >= 0)
      return 0.5;
   return SymbolInfoDouble(symbol, SYMBOL_VOLUME_MIN);
}

// Recovery: après une perte sur un symbole, le prochain signal sur un AUTRE symbole peut doubler le lot (une seule fois)
double ApplyRecoveryLot(double baseLot)
{
   bool recoverHere = (g_lossRecoverArmed && g_lossRecoverSymbol == _Symbol && g_symConsecLosses >= 1);
   if(!EnableLossRecoveryLot && !recoverHere) return baseLot;
   if(!recoverHere && (g_lastLossSymbol == "" || g_lastLossSymbol == _Symbol))
      return baseLot;
   double minL = GetMinLotForSymbol(_Symbol);
   double maxL = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_VOLUME_MAX);
   double recoveryLot = MathMin(maxL, 2.0 * minL);
   recoveryLot = NormalizeVolumeForSymbol(recoveryLot);
   if(recoveryLot < minL) recoveryLot = minL;
   string lostSym = recoverHere ? g_lossRecoverSymbol : g_lastLossSymbol;
   if(!recoverHere)
   {
      g_lastLossSymbol = "";
      g_lastLossTime   = 0;
   }
   Print("📈 RECOVERY - Lot ", DoubleToString(recoveryLot, 2), " sur ", _Symbol,
         " pour compenser perte(s) sur ", lostSym,
         recoverHere ? " (même symbole, 2+ pertes)" : "");
   return recoveryLot;
}

// Vérifie si, pour ce symbole, la décision IA est suffisamment forte
// ET alignée en direction (jamais contre-tendance IA) pour autoriser
// l'ouverture d'une nouvelle position (hors Boom/Crash).
bool IsAITradeAllowedForDirection(const string direction)
{
   if(!UseAIServer) return true; // Pas d'IA requise si serveur désactivé
   
   ENUM_SYMBOL_CATEGORY cat = SMC_GetSymbolCategory(_Symbol);
   // Sur Boom/Crash, on garde la logique actuelle DERIV ARROW + règles spécifiques
   if(cat == SYM_BOOM_CRASH) return true;
   
   // Seuil FIXE à 65% pour les autres symboles :
   // on ne trade QUE si l'IA est BUY ou SELL avec confiance suffisante.
   double minConf = 0.65;
   if(g_lastAIAction == "" || g_lastAIConfidence < minConf)
   {
      Print("🚫 TRADE BLOQUÉ - Pas de décision IA forte (conf: ",
            DoubleToString(g_lastAIConfidence*100, 1), "% < ",
            DoubleToString(minConf*100, 1), "%) sur ", _Symbol);
      return false;
   }
   
   if(g_lastAIAction == "HOLD" || g_lastAIAction == "hold")
   {
      Print("🚫 TRADE BLOQUÉ - IA en HOLD sur ", _Symbol, " (", DoubleToString(g_lastAIConfidence*100,1), "%)");
      return false;
   }

   // Ne jamais trader CONTRE la direction IA:
   // - Si IA = BUY, seules les entrées BUY sont autorisées
   // - Si IA = SELL, seules les entrées SELL sont autorisées
   string iaDir = g_lastAIAction;
   StringToUpper(iaDir);

   // On ne laisse trader que si l'IA est clairement BUY ou SELL
   if(iaDir != "BUY" && iaDir != "SELL")
   {
      Print("🚫 TRADE BLOQUÉ - Décision IA non directionnelle (", iaDir,
            ") ou incompatible pour ", _Symbol,
            " (conf: ", DoubleToString(g_lastAIConfidence*100,1), "%)");
      return false;
   }

   string dir = direction;
   StringToUpper(dir);

   if((iaDir == "BUY"  && dir != "BUY") ||
      (iaDir == "SELL" && dir != "SELL"))
   {
      Print("🚫 TRADE BLOQUÉ - Direction '", dir,
            "' contraire au signal IA '", iaDir,
            "' (conf: ", DoubleToString(g_lastAIConfidence*100,1), "%) sur ", _Symbol);
      return false;
   }

   return true;
}

//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| GOM Immediate Market + Retrace State Machine (tick handler)
//| - Met a jour les trackers de confirmation M1
//| - Gere la sortie par timeout (pas de spike / pas de confirmation)
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+

//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| v1.34: MARKET sur GOOD/PERFECT + M5 confirmée + niveau touché     |
//| Quand le dashboard clignote ENTER BUY/SELL et le prix touche une  |
//| zone (DOW EP / SR / GOM TL), on entre au marché.                   |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
bool TryExecuteGOMPerfectEntry()
{
   if(!GOMPerfectAutoEntry) return false;
   if(!g_smcGomConnected) return false;
   if(MathAbs(g_smcGomVerdictNum) < 2) return false; // GOOD ou PERFECT
   if(IsTerminalFull()) return false;
   if(CountPositionsOurEA() >= MaxPositionsTerminal) return false;
   if(CountPositionsForSymbol(_Symbol) > 0) return false;

   string src = g_smcGomSource;
   StringToUpper(src);
   if(StringFind(src, "CACHE_STALE") >= 0 || StringFind(src, "NO_HTTP") >= 0)
      return false;
   if(g_smcLastGOMPoll > 0 && (TimeCurrent() - g_smcLastGOMPoll) > 120)
      return false;

   int dirSign = (g_smcGomVerdictNum > 0) ? 1 : -1;
   string wantDir = (dirSign > 0) ? "BUY" : "SELL";

   // M5 clôturée dans le sens — obligatoire
   if(!SMC_HasM5Confirmation(_Symbol, dirSign))
   {
      static datetime s_m5w = 0;
      if(TimeCurrent() - s_m5w >= 30)
      {
         s_m5w = TimeCurrent();
         Print("[GOM-PERFECT] attente M5 clôturée ", wantDir, " | vn=", g_smcGomVerdictNum);
      }
      return false;
   }

   // Prix proche d'un niveau d'entrée (SMC / DOW / setup)
   string levelName = "";
   bool atLevel = SMC_IsAtValidSMCLevel(_Symbol, dirSign, levelName);
   // PERFECT (|vn|>=3) : tolérance élargie — si setup TV valide dans le même sens
   if(!atLevel && MathAbs(g_smcGomVerdictNum) >= 3 && g_smcSetupValid)
   {
      double entry = g_smcSetupEntry;
      double price = (dirSign > 0) ? SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK)
                                  : SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);
      double atr = 0;
      int hAtr = iATR(_Symbol, PERIOD_M5, 14);
      if(hAtr != INVALID_HANDLE)
      {
         double b[]; ArraySetAsSeries(b, true);
         if(CopyBuffer(hAtr, 0, 0, 1, b) >= 1) atr = b[0];
         IndicatorRelease(hAtr);
      }
      if(atr <= 0) atr = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_POINT) * 100;
      if(entry > 0 && MathAbs(price - entry) <= atr * 0.35)
      {
         atLevel = true;
         levelName = "GOM Setup Entry";
      }
   }
   // GOOD: aussi autoriser si proche du bid/ask récent swing dans le sens (0.25 ATR)
   if(!atLevel)
   {
      MqlRates r[]; ArraySetAsSeries(r, true);
      if(CopyRates(_Symbol, PERIOD_M5, 0, 15, r) >= 10)
      {
         double price = (dirSign > 0) ? SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK)
                                     : SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);
         double atr = MathMax(r[1].high - r[1].low, SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_POINT) * 10);
         if(dirSign > 0)
         {
            double swingLow = r[2].low;
            for(int i = 3; i < 12; i++) if(r[i].low < swingLow) swingLow = r[i].low;
            if(MathAbs(price - swingLow) <= atr * 0.40)
            { atLevel = true; levelName = "M5 Swing Low"; }
         }
         else
         {
            double swingHigh = r[2].high;
            for(int i = 3; i < 12; i++) if(r[i].high > swingHigh) swingHigh = r[i].high;
            if(MathAbs(price - swingHigh) <= atr * 0.40)
            { atLevel = true; levelName = "M5 Swing High"; }
         }
      }
   }
   if(!atLevel)
   {
      static datetime s_lv = 0;
      if(TimeCurrent() - s_lv >= 45)
      {
         s_lv = TimeCurrent();
         Print("[GOM-PERFECT] niveau non touché — attente pullback | ", wantDir,
               " vn=", g_smcGomVerdictNum);
      }
      return false;
   }

   // Cooldown anti-spam
   static datetime s_lastPerfectEntry = 0;
   static string   s_lastPerfectSym = "";
   if(s_lastPerfectSym == _Symbol && (TimeCurrent() - s_lastPerfectEntry) < 90)
      return false;

   if(!TryAcquireOpenLock()) return false;

   ENUM_ORDER_TYPE ot = (dirSign > 0) ? ORDER_TYPE_BUY : ORDER_TYPE_SELL;
   if(!SMC_FinalOpenGate(_Symbol, ot))
   {
      ReleaseOpenLock();
      return false;
   }

   double lot = CalculateLotSize();
   if(lot <= 0) { ReleaseOpenLock(); return false; }

   string cmt = "GOM_PERFECT " + wantDir + " " + levelName;
   bool ok = false;
   if(dirSign > 0)
      ok = SafeTradeBuy(lot, _Symbol, 0, 0, 0, cmt);
   else
      ok = SafeTradeSell(lot, _Symbol, 0, 0, 0, cmt);

   if(ok)
   {
      s_lastPerfectEntry = TimeCurrent();
      s_lastPerfectSym = _Symbol;
      SMC_GateRegisterOpened(_Symbol, dirSign > 0);
      Print("✅ GOM-PERFECT MARKET ", wantDir, " | ", _Symbol,
            " | vn=", g_smcGomVerdictNum, " | niveau=", levelName,
            " | lot=", DoubleToString(lot, 2));
   }
   else
      Print("❌ GOM-PERFECT échec OrderSend | ret=", trade.ResultRetcode(),
            " ", trade.ResultRetcodeDescription());

   ReleaseOpenLock();
   return ok;
}


void SMC_GOM_ImmediateOnTick()
{
   if(!UseGOMImmediateMarket) return;
   if(!g_smcGomConnected) return;

   // Mise a jour des compteurs de barres / confirmation M1
   GOM_UpdateConfirmationTrackers();

   // Sortie par timeout (pas de spike / pas de confirmation) des positions GOM immediates
   for(int i = PositionsTotal() - 1; i >= 0; i--)
   {
      if(!posInfo.SelectByIndex(i)) continue;
      if(posInfo.Magic() != InpMagicNumber) continue;
      string cmt = posInfo.Comment();
      if(!SMC_IsImmediateEntryComment(cmt)) continue;
      ulong ticket = posInfo.Ticket();

      int barsSinceEntry = 0;
      if(!GOM_ShouldExitDueToTimeout(ticket, barsSinceEntry)) continue;

      Print("[GOM-IMM] Timeout no-spike exit — #", ticket,
            " ", posInfo.Symbol(), " bars=", barsSinceEntry,
            " | ", cmt);
      if(!PositionCloseWithLog(ticket, "GOM_IMM timeout no-spike", true))
         Print("⚠️ Échec fermeture GOM_IMM timeout — ticket=", ticket,
               " err=", GetLastError());
   }
}

int OnInit()
{
   if(ShowCognitionPath || ShowPredictionChannel || ShowPredictedSwing)
   {
      if(!ChartSetInteger(0, CHART_SHIFT, true))
         Print("[PRED-CANDLES] Impossible d'activer le décalage graphique: ", GetLastError());
      if(!ChartSetDouble(0, CHART_SHIFT_SIZE, 35.0))
         Print("[PRED-CANDLES] Impossible de réserver la marge future: ", GetLastError());
   }

   // FIX 2026-09-05: initialise le moteur de strategies Boom/Crash/PainX/GainX
   // (etait ecrit mais jamais appele nulle part avant).
   SMC_BC_Init();
   ArrayFill(g_tickFreqBuf, 0, 60, 0);

   trade.SetExpertMagicNumber(InpMagicNumber);
   trade.SetDeviationInPoints(20);
   trade.SetTypeFilling(ORDER_FILLING_IOC);
   
   atrHandle = iATR(_Symbol, LTF, 14);
   emaHandle = iMA(_Symbol, LTF, 9, 0, MODE_EMA, PRICE_CLOSE);
   rsiSqueezeHandle = iRSI(_Symbol, PERIOD_M5, RSISqueezePeriod, PRICE_CLOSE);
   ema50H = iMA(_Symbol, HTF, EMA50_Period, 0, MODE_EMA, PRICE_CLOSE);
   ema200H = iMA(_Symbol, HTF, EMA200_Period, 0, MODE_EMA, PRICE_CLOSE);
    // EMAs SMC sur le timeframe d'entrée (LTF)
    ema21LTF = iMA(_Symbol, LTF, 21, 0, MODE_EMA, PRICE_CLOSE);
    ema23LTF = iMA(_Symbol, LTF, 23, 0, MODE_EMA, PRICE_CLOSE);
    ema25LTF = iMA(_Symbol, LTF, 25, 0, MODE_EMA, PRICE_CLOSE);
    ema28LTF = iMA(_Symbol, LTF, 28, 0, MODE_EMA, PRICE_CLOSE);
    ema31LTF = iMA(_Symbol, LTF, 31, 0, MODE_EMA, PRICE_CLOSE);

}

void OnTimer()
{
   SMC_SpikeBlink_WatchArrowOnTimer();
   if(g_spikeBlink.state != SPIKE_BLINK_IDLE)
      SMC_SpikeBlink_Toggle();
   SMCGP_OnTimer();

   // Canal + bougies futures : dessin visuel uniquement (aucun impact sur les gates d'entrée).
   static datetime s_lastForecastDraw = 0;
   if((ShowPredictionChannel || ShowPredictedSwing) &&
      TimeCurrent() - s_lastForecastDraw >= 5)
   {
      if(ShowPredictionChannel)
         DrawPredictionChannel();
      if(ShowPredictedSwing && PredictedCandlesCount > 0 && g_channelValid)
         DrawPredictedSwingPoints();
      s_lastForecastDraw = TimeCurrent();
   }
}

bool TryAcquireOpenLock()
{
   if(UseDailyCapitalManager)
   {
      string cmReason = "";
      if(CM_IsEntryBlocked(cmReason))
      {
         static datetime s_lastCmLog = 0;
         if(TimeCurrent() - s_lastCmLog >= 60)
         {
            Print("🛑 Capital Manager — entrée bloquée: ", cmReason);
            s_lastCmLog = TimeCurrent();
         }
         return false;
      }
   }

   // ── SESSION FILTER: Volatility hors fenêtre optimale → bloquer ──
   if(!SMC_IsVolSessionActive())
   {
      static datetime s_lastSessLog = 0;
      if(TimeCurrent() - s_lastSessLog >= 300)
      {
         Print("🕐 SESSION VOL — hors fenêtre (", VolSessionStart1, "h-", VolSessionEnd1, "h / ",
               VolSessionStart2, "h-", VolSessionEnd2, "h UTC) | ", _Symbol);
         s_lastSessLog = TimeCurrent();
      }
      return false;
   }

   // ── LOSS COOLDOWN: pause après perte récente sur ce symbole ──
   if(UseLossCooldown && IsRecentLossOnSymbol(_Symbol))
   {
      int remain = (int)(LossCooldownMinutes * 60 - (TimeCurrent() - g_lastLossTime));
      if(remain > 0)
      {
         static datetime s_lastCoolLog = 0;
         if(TimeCurrent() - s_lastCoolLog >= 60)
         {
            Print("⏳ COOLDOWN — perte récente sur ", _Symbol, " | reste ",
                  remain / 60, "min ", remain % 60, "s");
            s_lastCoolLog = TimeCurrent();
         }
         return false;
      }
   }

   string lockName = "SMC_OPEN_LOCK_" + IntegerToString(InpMagicNumber);
   string lockTimeName = lockName + "_TIME";
   
   // Vérification simple sans Sleep pour éviter détachement
   double lockValue = GlobalVariableGet(lockName);
   if(lockValue != 0)
   {
      // Vérifier si le lock est trop ancien (plus de 30 secondes) = deadlock possible
      double lockTime = GlobalVariableGet(lockTimeName);
      if(lockTime > 0 && (TimeCurrent() - lockTime) > 30)
      {
         Print("⚠️ OPEN LOCK TIMEOUT — libération forcée après ", (int)(TimeCurrent() - lockTime), "s");
         GlobalVariableSet(lockName, 0);
         GlobalVariableSet(lockTimeName, 0);
      }
      else
      {
         return false; // Lock actif et valide
      }
   }
   
   // Vérifier cooldown minimum entre deux ordres (2 secondes)
   static datetime s_lastOpenTime = 0;
   if(s_lastOpenTime > 0 && (TimeCurrent() - s_lastOpenTime) < 2)
   {
      return false; // Cooldown actif
   }
   
   // Acquérir le lock
   GlobalVariableSet(lockName, 1);
   GlobalVariableSet(lockTimeName, (double)TimeCurrent());
   
   if(IsTerminalFull()) 
   { 
      GlobalVariableSet(lockName, 0); 
      GlobalVariableSet(lockTimeName, 0);
      return false; 
   }
   
   s_lastOpenTime = TimeCurrent();
   return true;
}
void ReleaseOpenLock() 
{ 
   GlobalVariableSet("SMC_OPEN_LOCK_" + IntegerToString(InpMagicNumber), 0); 
   GlobalVariableSet("SMC_OPEN_LOCK_" + IntegerToString(InpMagicNumber) + "_TIME", 0); 
   // CORRECTIF DUPLICATION (demande Sidoine) : ReleaseOpenLock() est appelé à
   // TOUS les points de sortie (~30 sites), succès ou échec, après chaque
   // tentative d'ouverture. SMC_ReleaseTerminalOpenLock() était définie mais
   // n'était jamais appelée nulle part dans tout le fichier : le verrou global
   // inter-graphiques posé par SMC_AcquireTerminalOpenLock() (dans
   // SMC_FinalOpenGate) restait donc actif jusqu'à expiration (90s), qu'une
   // position ait réellement été ouverte ou non. On le libère ici aussi ;
   // SMC_ReleaseTerminalOpenLock() ne supprime le verrou QUE s'il n'y a
   // effectivement aucune position ouverte de notre EA (CountPositionsOurEA()==0),
   // donc si l'ouverture a réussi, le verrou reste bien en place tant que la
   // position existe — ce qui est exactement le comportement voulu : jamais
   // une 2e position tant que la 1ère est ouverte, mais pas de blocage inutile
   // si la tentative a échoué.
   SMC_ReleaseTerminalOpenLock();
}

//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| Helper pour normaliser le SL selon le minimum step du broker     |
//| FIX 2026-09-20: Ajout vérification distance minimale (stops level)|
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
double NormalizeSLForBroker(const string symbol, double newSL, double currentSL)
{
   if(newSL == currentSL) return newSL;
   
   double point = SymbolInfoDouble(symbol, SYMBOL_POINT);
   long digits = SymbolInfoInteger(symbol, SYMBOL_DIGITS);
   double minStep = SymbolInfoDouble(symbol, SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_SIZE);
   if(minStep <= 0.0) minStep = point;
   
   // FIX 2026-09-20: Vérifier distance minimale exigée par le broker (stops level)
   int stopsLvl = (int)SymbolInfoInteger(symbol, SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL);
   double minDist = (double)(stopsLvl + 2) * point;
   
   double bid = SymbolInfoDouble(symbol, SYMBOL_BID);
   double ask = SymbolInfoDouble(symbol, SYMBOL_ASK);
   
   // Vérifier que le SL respecte la distance minimale par rapport au prix
   bool isBuySL = (newSL < bid); // SL pour position BUY est sous le prix
   if(isBuySL && (bid - newSL) < minDist)
   {
      // Ajuster pour respecter la distance minimale
      newSL = NormalizeDouble(bid - minDist, (int)digits);
   }
   else if(!isBuySL && (newSL - ask) < minDist)
   {
      // SL pour position SELL est au-dessus du prix
      newSL = NormalizeDouble(ask + minDist, (int)digits);
   }
   
   double slDiff = MathAbs(newSL - currentSL);
   if(slDiff < minStep && slDiff > 0.0)
   {
      // Ajuster au step le plus proche
      if(newSL > currentSL)
         newSL = NormalizeDouble(currentSL + MathCeil((newSL - currentSL) / minStep) * minStep, (int)digits);
      else
         newSL = NormalizeDouble(currentSL + MathFloor((newSL - currentSL) / minStep) * minStep, (int)digits);
   }
   
   return newSL;
}

void OnDeinit(const int reason)
{
   // Diagnostic du détachement - identifier la cause exacte
   string reasonStr = "";
   switch(reason)
   {
      case REASON_PROGRAM:     reasonStr = "EA supprimé manuellement"; break;
      case REASON_REMOVE:      reasonStr = "EA retiré du graphique"; break;
      case REASON_RECOMPILE:   reasonStr = "EA recompilé"; break;
      case REASON_CHARTCHANGE: reasonStr = "Symbole/période changé"; break;
      case REASON_CHARTCLOSE:  reasonStr = "Graphique fermé"; break;
      case REASON_PARAMETERS:  reasonStr = "Paramètres modifiés"; break;
      case REASON_ACCOUNT:     reasonStr = "Compte changé"; break;
      case REASON_TEMPLATE:    reasonStr = "Template appliqué"; break;
      case REASON_INITFAILED:  reasonStr = "OnInit a échoué (CRASH)"; break;
      case REASON_CLOSE:       reasonStr = "Terminal fermé"; break;
      default:                 reasonStr = "Autre (code " + IntegerToString(reason) + ")"; break;
   }
   Print("🚨 DÉTACHEMENT ROBOT SMC | ", _Symbol, " | Raison: ", reasonStr);
   if(reason == REASON_INITFAILED)
      Print("⚠️ CAUSE: Erreur dans OnInit ou crash (indicateurs, mémoire, etc.)");

   SMC_SpikeBlink_Deinit();
   SMCGP_Deinit();

   // Cleanup new algorithmic modules
   SMC_AI_Deinit();              // Adaptive Instrument Filtering
   SMC_Range_Deinit();           // Advanced Range Detection
   SMC_Risk_Deinit();            // Advanced Risk Manager
   SMC_PGI_Deinit();             // Pattern-GOM Integration
   SMC_MSR_Deinit();             // Missed Spike Reentry
   SMC_DTE_Deinit();             // DOW Touch Entry
   SMC_PC_Deinit();              // Performance Cache
   SMC_OPF_Deinit();             // Opportunity Filter
   SMC_GOMTrust_Deinit();        // GOM Trust System

   if(atrHandle != INVALID_HANDLE) { IndicatorRelease(atrHandle); atrHandle = INVALID_HANDLE; }
   if(emaHandle != INVALID_HANDLE) { IndicatorRelease(emaHandle); emaHandle = INVALID_HANDLE; }
   if(ema50H != INVALID_HANDLE) { IndicatorRelease(ema50H); ema50H = INVALID_HANDLE; }

   if(emaM5H != INVALID_HANDLE) { IndicatorRelease(emaM5H); emaM5H = INVALID_HANDLE; }
   if(emaH1H != INVALID_HANDLE) { IndicatorRelease(emaH1H); emaH1H = INVALID_HANDLE; }

   if(emaSlowM1 != INVALID_HANDLE) { IndicatorRelease(emaSlowM1); emaSlowM1 = INVALID_HANDLE; }
   if(emaFastM5 != INVALID_HANDLE) { IndicatorRelease(emaFastM5); emaFastM5 = INVALID_HANDLE; }
   if(emaSlowM5 != INVALID_HANDLE) { IndicatorRelease(emaSlowM5); emaSlowM5 = INVALID_HANDLE; }
   if(emaFastH1 != INVALID_HANDLE) { IndicatorRelease(emaFastH1); emaFastH1 = INVALID_HANDLE; }
   if(emaSlowH1 != INVALID_HANDLE) { IndicatorRelease(emaSlowH1); emaSlowH1 = INVALID_HANDLE; }
   if(atrM1 != INVALID_HANDLE) { IndicatorRelease(atrM1); atrM1 = INVALID_HANDLE; }
   if(atrM5 != INVALID_HANDLE) { IndicatorRelease(atrM5); atrM5 = INVALID_HANDLE; }
   if(atrH1 != INVALID_HANDLE) { IndicatorRelease(atrH1); atrH1 = INVALID_HANDLE; }
   if(atrH4 != INVALID_HANDLE) { IndicatorRelease(atrH4); atrH4 = INVALID_HANDLE; }
   g_spikePredictor.Deinit();
   ChainPred_Cleanup();
   CrossCorr_Cleanup();
   DowTrendline_Cleanup();

   SH_Cleanup();
   if(UseOTEStrategy) OTE_ReleaseHandles();

   ObjectDelete(0, "RECON_EXEC_" + _Symbol);
   ObjectDelete(0, "RECON_ARROW_" + _Symbol);
   SMC_FVGBox_Deinit();
    if(ema21LTF != INVALID_HANDLE) { IndicatorRelease(ema21LTF); ema21LTF = INVALID_HANDLE; }
   if(ema31LTF != INVALID_HANDLE) { IndicatorRelease(ema31LTF); ema31LTF = INVALID_HANDLE; }

bool IsBullishHTF()
{
   if(ema50H == INVALID_HANDLE || ema200H == INVALID_HANDLE) return false;
   double f[], s[];
   ArraySetAsSeries(f, true); ArraySetAsSeries(s, true);
   if(CopyBuffer(ema50H, 0, 0, 1, f) < 1 || CopyBuffer(ema200H, 0, 0, 1, s) < 1) return false;
   return f[0] > s[0];
}
bool IsBearishHTF()
{
   if(ema50H == INVALID_HANDLE || ema200H == INVALID_HANDLE) return false;
   double f[], s[];
   ArraySetAsSeries(f, true); ArraySetAsSeries(s, true);
   if(CopyBuffer(ema50H, 0, 0, 1, f) < 1 || CopyBuffer(ema200H, 0, 0, 1, s) < 1) return false;
   return f[0] < s[0];
}
bool FVGKill_LiquiditySweepDetected()
{
   double prevHigh = iHigh(_Symbol, LTF, 2);
   double prevLow  = iLow(_Symbol, LTF, 2);
   double h1 = iHigh(_Symbol, LTF, 1);
   double l1 = iLow(_Symbol, LTF, 1);
   return (h1 > prevHigh || l1 < prevLow);
}
bool FVGKill_SweepConfirmed(int minBarsAgo = 2)
{
   string lsType;
   int barsAgo = 0;
   if(!SMC_DetectLiquiditySweepEx(_Symbol, LTF, lsType, barsAgo)) return false;
   return (barsAgo >= minBarsAgo);
}

bool IsInDiscountZone()
{
   double high[], low[], close[];
   ArraySetAsSeries(high, true); ArraySetAsSeries(low, true); ArraySetAsSeries(close, true);
   if(CopyHigh(_Symbol, PERIOD_H1, 0, 100, high) < 100 || CopyLow(_Symbol, PERIOD_H1, 0, 100, low) < 100 || CopyClose(_Symbol, PERIOD_H1, 0, 100, close) < 100) return false;
   int n = ArraySize(close);
   if(n < 25) return false;
   double sma20[];
   ArrayResize(sma20, n);
   ArraySetAsSeries(sma20, true);
   for(int i = 0; i < n - 20; i++) { double s = 0; for(int j = 0; j < 20; j++) s += close[i + j]; sma20[i] = s / 20; }
   for(int i = n - 20; i < n; i++) sma20[i] = sma20[MathMax(0, n - 21)];
   double eq = sma20[0];
   double discLow = low[ArrayMinimum(low, 0, 20)];
   double bid = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);
   return (bid >= discLow && bid <= eq && discLow < eq);
}
bool IsInPremiumZone()
{
   double high[], low[], close[];
   ArraySetAsSeries(high, true); ArraySetAsSeries(low, true); ArraySetAsSeries(close, true);
   if(CopyHigh(_Symbol, PERIOD_H1, 0, 100, high) < 100 || CopyLow(_Symbol, PERIOD_H1, 0, 100, low) < 100 || CopyClose(_Symbol, PERIOD_H1, 0, 100, close) < 100) return false;
   int n = ArraySize(close);
   if(n < 25) return false;
   double sma20[];
   ArrayResize(sma20, n);
   ArraySetAsSeries(sma20, true);
   for(int i = 0; i < n - 20; i++) { double s = 0; for(int j = 0; j < 20; j++) s += close[i + j]; sma20[i] = s / 20; }
   for(int i = n - 20; i < n; i++) sma20[i] = sma20[MathMax(0, n - 21)];
   double eq = sma20[0];
   double premHigh = high[ArrayMaximum(high, 0, 20)];
   double ask = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK);
   return (ask >= eq && ask <= premHigh && premHigh > eq);
}

//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| Entrée MARKET au touch du rectangle DOW EP (DOW_CORRECTION_RECT)  |
//| Verdict GOM GOOD/PERFECT + M1/M5/M15 alignés                     |
//| + structure (zone discount/premium) + tendance claire (EMA H1)    |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
void SMC_TryDowEpRectMarketEntry()
{
   if(!UseDowEpRectMarketEntry) return;

   string symUpper = _Symbol;
   StringToUpper(symUpper);
   bool isSpike = (StringFind(symUpper, "BOOM") >= 0 || StringFind(symUpper, "CRASH") >= 0 ||
                   StringFind(symUpper, "PAINX") >= 0 || StringFind(symUpper, "GAINX") >= 0 ||
                   SMC_GetSymbolCategory(_Symbol) == SYM_VOLATILITY);
   if(!isSpike) return;

   if(CountPositionsForSymbol(_Symbol) > 0) return;

   // ── Verdict GOOD/PERFECT uniquement (|vn|>=2) — WAIT/SIMPLE bloqués ──
   if(!g_smcGomConnected || g_smcGomVerdictNum == 0) return;
   if(!SMCGP_IsGoodPerfect(g_smcGomVerdictNum)) return;
   bool isBearish = (g_smcGomVerdictNum < 0);
   if(!SMC_SpikeBlink_TripleTFAligned(isBearish ? -1 : 1)) return;

   // FIX 2026-09-08 (Claude, demande Sidoine): garde correction M5 pour SIMPLE.
   // FIX 2026-09-09 (Claude, demande Sidoine): l'hypothèse "GOOD/PERFECT restent
   // couverts par ailleurs" était fausse — structure (discount/premium) + tendance
   // H1 ne détectent PAS un retracement M5 en cours (EMA21/EMA50 traversées, ATR
   // compressé, range étroit). GOOD/PERFECT pouvait donc rentrer en pleine
   // correction, comme SIMPLE avant le fix d'hier. Garde désormais appliquée à
   // TOUS les verdicts (SIMPLE, GOOD, PERFECT) — plus d'exception.
   int rectDirSign = isBearish ? -1 : 1;

   // ── Structure : zone discount/premium (proxy MasterScore, indisponible) ──
   if(isBearish && !IsInPremiumZone()) return;
   if(!isBearish && !IsInDiscountZone()) return;

   // ── Tendance claire EMA50H vs EMA200H ──
   if(!isBearish && !IsBullishHTF()) return;
   if(isBearish && !IsBearishHTF()) return;

   int dg = (int)SymbolInfoInteger(_Symbol, SYMBOL_DIGITS);
   double bid = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);
   double ask = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK);
   double epPrice = 0.0;
   string epToken = isBearish ? "DOW_BEAR_EP" : "DOW_BULL_EP";
   if(!SMC_FindReactionObjectLevel(_Symbol, epToken, epPrice) || epPrice <= 0.0)
      epPrice = (g_dowState.currentEpPrice > 0.0) ? g_dowState.currentEpPrice
               : ((g_dowState.projectedPrice > 0.0) ? g_dowState.projectedPrice : 0.0);
   if(epPrice <= 0.0) return;

   // ── Touché EP: Bull→low retrace ≤ EP, Bear→high retrace ≥ EP ──
   double low1 = iLow(_Symbol, PERIOD_M1, 0);
   double high1 = iHigh(_Symbol, PERIOD_M1, 0);
   bool epTouched = isBearish ? (high1 >= epPrice) : (low1 <= epPrice);

   static datetime s_rectTouchBar = 0;
   if(epTouched)
      s_rectTouchBar = iTime(_Symbol, PERIOD_M1, 0);

   // Attendre 1 bougie M1 après le touché
   if(s_rectTouchBar == 0 || iTime(_Symbol, PERIOD_M1, 0) <= s_rectTouchBar) return;

   // ── Cooldown entre 2 entrées rectangle ──
   static datetime s_lastRectEntry = 0;
   if(s_lastRectEntry > 0 && TimeCurrent() - s_lastRectEntry < DowEpRectCooldownSec) return;

   // ⛔ Pattern Forecast hard block
   if(Dow_PatternForecastBlocksTrade()) return;

   // ── ATR (garde standard) ──
   double atrVal = 0.0;
   double atrBuf[];
   ArraySetAsSeries(atrBuf, true);
   if(atrHandle != INVALID_HANDLE && CopyBuffer(atrHandle, 0, 0, 2, atrBuf) >= 2)
      atrVal = atrBuf[1];
   if(atrVal <= 0.0) return;

   if(!SMC_HasM1LevelRejection(isBearish ? -1 : 1, epPrice, atrVal))
   {
      Print("⏳ DOW EP touch sans rejet M1 exploitable — pas d'entrée tardive sur ",
            _Symbol, " | EP=", DoubleToString(epPrice, dg));
      return;
   }

   // ── Gate final (cap global, anti-hedge, OTE, tracker) ──
   if(!SMC_FinalOpenGate(_Symbol, isBearish ? ORDER_TYPE_SELL : ORDER_TYPE_BUY)) return;

   double lot = CalculateLotSize();
   if(lot <= 0.0) return;

   MqlTradeRequest rectReq = {};
   MqlTradeResult  rectRes = {};
   rectReq.action    = TRADE_ACTION_DEAL;
   rectReq.symbol    = _Symbol;
   rectReq.volume    = lot;
   rectReq.magic     = InpMagicNumber;
   rectReq.deviation = 30;

   if(isBearish)
   {
      rectReq.type    = ORDER_TYPE_SELL;
      rectReq.price   = bid;
      rectReq.sl      = NormalizeDouble(bid + atrVal * DOW_SL_ATRMULT, dg);
      rectReq.tp      = NormalizeDouble(bid - atrVal * DOW_TP_ATRMULT, dg);
      rectReq.comment = "DOW RECT SELL";
   }
   else
   {
      rectReq.type    = ORDER_TYPE_BUY;
      rectReq.price   = ask;
      rectReq.sl      = NormalizeDouble(ask - atrVal * DOW_SL_ATRMULT, dg);
      rectReq.tp      = NormalizeDouble(ask + atrVal * DOW_TP_ATRMULT, dg);
      rectReq.comment = "DOW RECT BUY";
   }

   if(SafeOrderSend(rectReq, rectRes, rectReq.comment) && rectRes.retcode == TRADE_RETCODE_DONE)
   {
      s_lastRectEntry = TimeCurrent();
      s_rectTouchBar = 0;
      string tsRect = TimeToString(TimeCurrent(), TIME_DATE|TIME_SECONDS);
      Print("📐 DOW RECT ", (isBearish ? "SELL" : "BUY"), " MARKET @ ", rectReq.price,
            " (touch rectangle EP) | SL=", rectReq.sl, " | TP=", rectReq.tp, " ", tsRect);
      if(UseNotifications)
         SendNotification("📐 DOW RECT " + (isBearish ? "SELL" : "BUY") + " MARKET " + _Symbol +
                          " @ " + DoubleToString(rectReq.price, dg) +
                          " SL=" + DoubleToString(rectReq.sl, dg) +
                          " TP=" + DoubleToString(rectReq.tp, dg) +
                          " " + tsRect);
   }
   else
      Print("❌ DOW RECT MARKET failed: ", rectRes.retcode, " - ", rectRes.comment);
}

//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| CONTRE-TENDANCE CHARTISTE (recouvrement de perte, EXCEPTIONNEL)  |
//| SELL sur Boom/GainX ou BUY sur Crash/PainX, UNIQUEMENT si une    |
//| figure chartiste confirmée (avec entry+target) est servie par    |
//| ai_server via GET /chartist/counter_trend/{symbol}. Bridé par :  |
//| opt-in explicite, score/RR mini, tolérance de prix vs l'entry,   |
//| cooldown + quota journalier LOCAL (en plus du garde-fou serveur),|
//| lot réduit, et toutes les autres gardes de sécurité habituelles  |
//| (SMC_FinalOpenGate : cap global, anti-hedge, reaction tracker).  |
//| Ne passe PAS par CanTradeOnSymbol()/CanPlaceMarketOrder() car ce |
//| sont eux qui imposent "Boom/Gainx=BUY only, Crash/Painx=SELL     |
//| only" — c'est précisément cette règle qu'on lève ici, à titre    |
//| exceptionnel et non systématique.                                |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
struct SMC_CounterTrendState
{
   string   symbol;
   datetime lastEntryTime;
   int      countToday;
   long     dayStamp;
};
SMC_CounterTrendState g_ctState[64];
int g_ctStateCount = 0;

int SMC_GetCounterTrendState(const string symbol)
{
   for(int i = 0; i < g_ctStateCount; i++)
      if(g_ctState[i].symbol == symbol) return i;
   if(g_ctStateCount >= 64) return -1;
   int n = g_ctStateCount++;
   g_ctState[n].symbol = symbol;
   g_ctState[n].lastEntryTime = 0;
   g_ctState[n].countToday = 0;
   g_ctState[n].dayStamp = 0;
   return n;
}

void SMC_TryChartistCounterTrendEntry()
{
   if(!AllowCounterTrendChartistRecovery) return;

   // FIX v1.34: BLOQUER si verdict est WAIT
   if(g_smcGomVerdictNum == 0) return;

   bool isBoom  = IsBoomLikeSymbol(_Symbol);
   bool isCrash = IsCrashLikeSymbol(_Symbol);
   if(!isBoom && !isCrash) return; // uniquement Boom/GainX/Crash/PainX, comme demandé

   if(CountPositionsForSymbol(_Symbol) > 0) return; // jamais si déjà en position sur ce symbole
   if(IsTerminalFull()) return;

   int st = SMC_GetCounterTrendState(_Symbol);
   if(st < 0) return;

   datetime now = TimeCurrent();

   // Quota journalier + cooldown LOCAUX (ceinture + bretelles en plus du
   // garde-fou déjà appliqué côté ai_server) — "pas systématique".
   long today = (long)now / 86400;
   if(g_ctState[st].dayStamp != today)
   {
      g_ctState[st].dayStamp = today;
      g_ctState[st].countToday = 0;
   }
   if(g_ctState[st].countToday >= CounterTrendMaxPerDay) return;
   if(g_ctState[st].lastEntryTime > 0 && (now - g_ctState[st].lastEntryTime) < CounterTrendCooldownSec) return;

   // Anti-spam requêtes HTTP : 1 poll / 20s max
   static datetime s_lastCTPoll = 0;
   if(now - s_lastCTPoll < 20) return;
   s_lastCTPoll = now;

   string symEnc = _Symbol;
   StringReplace(symEnc, " ", "%20");
   string body = "";
   if(!SMCGP_HttpGet("/chartist/counter_trend/" + symEnc, body, 4000)) return;
   if(!SMCGP_JsonBool(body, "ok")) return;

   string pattern   = SMCGP_JsonString(body, "pattern");
   string direction = SMCGP_JsonString(body, "direction");
   bool   confirmed = SMCGP_JsonBool(body, "confirmed");
   bool   isCT      = SMCGP_JsonBool(body, "counter_trend");
   double entryLvl  = SMCGP_JsonDouble(body, "entry", 0.0);
   double slLvl     = SMCGP_JsonDouble(body, "sl", 0.0);
   double tpLvl     = SMCGP_JsonDouble(body, "tp", 0.0);
   double score     = SMCGP_JsonDouble(body, "score", 0.0);
   double rr        = SMCGP_JsonDouble(body, "rr", 0.0);

   // Figure absente, pas confirmée, ou pas explicitement taguée contre-tendance
   // par le serveur → on ne prend aucun risque, on abandonne.
   if(!confirmed || !isCT) return;
   if(StringLen(direction) == 0 || entryLvl <= 0.0 || slLvl <= 0.0 || tpLvl <= 0.0) return;
   if(score < CounterTrendMinScore || rr < CounterTrendMinRR) return;

   StringToUpper(direction);
   int dirSign = (direction == "BUY") ? 1 : (direction == "SELL" ? -1 : 0);
   if(dirSign == 0) return;

   // Sécurité supplémentaire : ce chemin ne sert QUE le sens contre-tendance.
   // Si jamais le serveur renvoyait par erreur le sens natif ici, on refuse —
   // ce chemin ne doit jamais devenir une 2e voie pour le sens normal.
   if(isBoom && dirSign > 0) return;   // Boom/GainX natif = BUY → ici on n'autorise que SELL
   if(isCrash && dirSign < 0) return;  // Crash/PainX natif = SELL → ici on n'autorise que BUY

   // Le niveau d'entrée affiché (pointillé) doit encore être d'actualité :
   // le prix ne doit pas s'en être trop éloigné.
   double atr = 0.0;
   double ab[];
   ArraySetAsSeries(ab, true);
   if(atrHandle != INVALID_HANDLE && CopyBuffer(atrHandle, 0, 0, 1, ab) >= 1)
      atr = ab[0];
   if(atr <= 0.0) atr = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_POINT) * 50.0;

   double bid = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);
   double ask = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK);
   if(bid <= 0.0 || ask <= 0.0) return;
   double px = (bid + ask) * 0.5;
   if(MathAbs(px - entryLvl) > atr * MathMax(0.1, CounterTrendEntryATRTol)) return;

   // Gate final classique : cap global, anti-hedge, reaction tracker, OTE si
   // actif sur ce symbole. Volontairement PAS de CanTradeOnSymbol() /
   // CanPlaceMarketOrder() : ce sont eux qui imposent la règle native
   // "Boom/Gainx=BUY only, Crash/Painx=SELL only" — la lever est le but de
   // cette fonction, à titre exceptionnel et sur figure de haute qualité.
   ENUM_ORDER_TYPE ot = (dirSign > 0) ? ORDER_TYPE_BUY : ORDER_TYPE_SELL;
   if(!SMC_FinalOpenGate(_Symbol, ot)) return;

   double lot = CalculateLotSize() * MathMax(0.05, CounterTrendLotMultiplier);
   lot = NormalizeVolumeForSymbol(lot);
   if(lot <= 0.0) return;

   int dg = (int)SymbolInfoInteger(_Symbol, SYMBOL_DIGITS);
   double sl = NormalizeDouble(slLvl, dg);
   double tp = NormalizeDouble(tpLvl, dg);

   if(!TryAcquireOpenLock()) return;
   bool ok = false;
   string cmt = "CT RECOVERY " + pattern;
   if(dirSign > 0)
      ok = SafeTradeBuy(lot, _Symbol, ask, sl, tp, cmt);
   else
      ok = SafeTradeSell(lot, _Symbol, bid, sl, tp, cmt);
   ReleaseOpenLock();

   if(ok)
   {
      g_ctState[st].lastEntryTime = now;
      g_ctState[st].countToday++;
      RegisterOrderPlaced();
      SMC_GateRegisterOpened(_Symbol, dirSign > 0);

      Print("🎯 CONTRE-TENDANCE RECOVERY ", direction, " MARKET | ", _Symbol,
            " | figure=", pattern, " score=", DoubleToString(score, 2),
            " rr=", DoubleToString(rr, 2), " | entry~", DoubleToString(entryLvl, dg),
            " SL=", DoubleToString(sl, dg), " TP=", DoubleToString(tp, dg),
            " | lot=", DoubleToString(lot, 2), " | EXCEPTIONNEL — quota ",
            g_ctState[st].countToday, "/", CounterTrendMaxPerDay, " aujourd'hui sur ", _Symbol);
      if(UseNotifications)
         SendNotification("🎯 CT RECOVERY " + direction + " " + _Symbol + " | " + pattern +
                          " score=" + DoubleToString(score, 2));

      // Libère le slot côté ai_server (retire l'ordre du store contre-tendance)
      string ackBody = "{\"mt5_ticket\":\"" + IntegerToString((long)trade.ResultOrder()) + "\"}";
      SMCGP_HttpPost("/chartist/counter_trend/" + symEnc + "/executed", ackBody, 3000);
   }
   else
   {
      Print("❌ CONTRE-TENDANCE RECOVERY échouée ", direction, " sur ", _Symbol,
            " | err=", GetLastError());
   }
}

//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| ENTRÉES CHARTISTE NORMALES — figures native direction (SMC_OTE,  |
//| triangles, double bottom, BOS+FVG+OB...) via ai_server.          |
//| Voie NORMALE (≠ contre-tendance) : GOM GOOD/PERFECT requis, sens |
//| natif Boom/Crash respecté, SL/TP serveur.                        |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
void SMC_TryChartistOrderEntry()
{
   if(!UseChartistOrderEntries) return;

   if(IsTerminalFull()) return;
   if(CountPositionsForSymbol(_Symbol) > 0) return; // jamais en pile sur le même symbole

   // Anti-spam HTTP : 1 détection / ChartistOrderPollSec
   static datetime s_lastChartistPoll = 0;
   datetime now = TimeCurrent();
   if(now - s_lastChartistPoll < ChartistOrderPollSec) return;
   s_lastChartistPoll = now;

   // Payload avec les 96 dernières bougies M1 → fraîcheur garantie :
   // l'entrée est calculée sur ces bougies (pas de store serveur stale).
   MqlRates rlist[];
   int got = CopyRates(_Symbol, PERIOD_M1, 0, 96, rlist);
   if(got < 40) return;
   int dg = (int)SymbolInfoInteger(_Symbol, SYMBOL_DIGITS);
   string candles = "";
   for(int i = 0; i < got; i++)
   {
      MqlRates r = rlist[i];
      if(i > 0) candles += ",";
      candles += StringFormat("{\"open\":%s,\"high\":%s,\"low\":%s,\"close\":%s,\"volume\":%f}",
                  DoubleToString(r.open, dg), DoubleToString(r.high, dg),
                  DoubleToString(r.low,  dg), DoubleToString(r.close, dg), (double)r.tick_volume);
   }
   string body = "{\"candles\":[" + candles + "]}";

   string symEnc = _Symbol;
   StringReplace(symEnc, " ", "%20");
   string resp = "";
   if(!SMCGP_HttpPostWithResponse("/chartist/detect/" + symEnc, body, resp, 6000)) return;
   if(!SMCGP_JsonBool(resp, "ok")) return;

   // best == orders[0] côté serveur → le premier hit JSON est le best.
   string pattern   = SMCGP_JsonString(resp, "pattern");
   string direction = SMCGP_JsonString(resp, "direction");
   bool   confirmed = SMCGP_JsonBool(resp, "confirmed");
   bool   isCT      = SMCGP_JsonBool(resp, "counter_trend");
   double entryLvl  = SMCGP_JsonDouble(resp, "entry", 0.0);
   double slLvl     = SMCGP_JsonDouble(resp, "sl", 0.0);
   double tpLvl     = SMCGP_JsonDouble(resp, "tp", 0.0);
   double score     = SMCGP_JsonDouble(resp, "score", 0.0);
   double rr        = SMCGP_JsonDouble(resp, "rr", 0.0);

   // Figure absente / pas confirmée / taguée contre-tendance → abandon.
   if(!confirmed || isCT) return;
   if(StringLen(pattern) == 0 || StringLen(direction) == 0) return;
   if(entryLvl <= 0.0 || slLvl <= 0.0 || tpLvl <= 0.0) return;
   if(score < ChartistOrderMinScore || rr < ChartistOrderMinRR) return;

   StringToUpper(direction);
   int dirSign = (direction == "BUY") ? 1 : (direction == "SELL" ? -1 : 0);
   if(dirSign == 0) return;

   // Sens natif respecté (Boom/GainX = BUY uniquement, Crash/PainX = SELL uniquement)
   if(IsBoomLikeSymbol(_Symbol) && dirSign < 0) return;
   if(IsCrashLikeSymbol(_Symbol) && dirSign > 0) return;

   // SL/TP cohérents par rapport au niveau d'entrée
   if(dirSign > 0 && (slLvl >= entryLvl || tpLvl <= entryLvl)) return;
   if(dirSign < 0 && (slLvl <= entryLvl || tpLvl >= entryLvl)) return;

   // Le prix ne doit pas s'être trop éloigné du niveau d'entrée affiché
   double atr = 0.0;
   double ab[];
   ArraySetAsSeries(ab, true);
   if(atrHandle != INVALID_HANDLE && CopyBuffer(atrHandle, 0, 0, 1, ab) >= 1)
      atr = ab[0];
   if(atr <= 0.0) atr = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_POINT) * 50.0;

   double bid = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);
   double ask = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK);
   if(bid <= 0.0 || ask <= 0.0) return;
   double px = (bid + ask) * 0.5;
   if(MathAbs(px - entryLvl) > atr * MathMax(0.1, ChartistOrderEntryATRTol)) return;

   // Gate GOM voie normale : GOOD/PERFECT + direction alignée + connecté
   if(!SMC_EntryVerdictOK(_Symbol, dirSign)) return;

   // Gates classiques voie normale (nano, réaction, OTE, discipline...)
   ENUM_ORDER_TYPE ot = (dirSign > 0) ? ORDER_TYPE_BUY : ORDER_TYPE_SELL;
   if(!CanTradeOnSymbol(_Symbol, direction)) return;
   if(!CanPlaceMarketOrder(_Symbol, dirSign)) return;
   if(!SMC_FinalOpenGate(_Symbol, ot)) return;

   double lot = CalculateLotSize();
   lot = NormalizeVolumeForSymbol(lot);
   if(lot <= 0.0) return;

   double sl = NormalizeDouble(slLvl, dg);
   double tp = NormalizeDouble(tpLvl, dg);

   if(!TryAcquireOpenLock()) return;
   bool ok = false;
   string cmt = "CHARTIST " + pattern;
   if(dirSign > 0)
      ok = SafeTradeBuy(lot, _Symbol, ask, sl, tp, cmt);
   else
      ok = SafeTradeSell(lot, _Symbol, bid, sl, tp, cmt);
   ReleaseOpenLock();

   if(ok)
   {
      RegisterOrderPlaced();
      SMC_GateRegisterOpened(_Symbol, dirSign > 0);
      Print("🚀 CHARTISTE ", direction, " MARKET | ", _Symbol, " | figure=", pattern,
            " score=", DoubleToString(score, 2), " rr=", DoubleToString(rr, 2),
            " | entry~", DoubleToString(entryLvl, dg), " SL=", DoubleToString(sl, dg),
            " TP=", DoubleToString(tp, dg), " | lot=", DoubleToString(lot, 2));
      if(UseNotifications)
         SendNotification("🚀 CHARTISTE " + direction + " " + _Symbol + " | " + pattern +
                          " score=" + DoubleToString(score, 2));

      // Libère le slot côté ai_server (retire l'ordre du store chartiste)
      string ackBody = "{\"mt5_ticket\":\"" + IntegerToString((long)trade.ResultOrder()) + "\"}";
      SMCGP_HttpPost("/chartist/order/" + symEnc + "/executed", ackBody, 3000);
   }
   else
   {
      Print("❌ CHARTISTE échouée ", direction, " sur ", _Symbol,
            " | err=", GetLastError());
   }
}

// Protection capital: vrai si en zone Discount et prix a touché le bord inférieur (zone d'achat)
// Utilisé pour exiger confiance IA >= 85% avant d'exécuter un SELL dans ce cas.
bool IsAtDiscountLowerEdge()
{
   double high[], low[], close[];
   ArraySetAsSeries(high, true); ArraySetAsSeries(low, true); ArraySetAsSeries(close, true);
   if(CopyHigh(_Symbol, PERIOD_H1, 0, 100, high) < 100 || CopyLow(_Symbol, PERIOD_H1, 0, 100, low) < 100 || CopyClose(_Symbol, PERIOD_H1, 0, 100, close) < 100) return false;
   int n = ArraySize(close);
   if(n < 25) return false;
   double sma20[];
   ArrayResize(sma20, n);
   ArraySetAsSeries(sma20, true);
   for(int i = 0; i < n - 20; i++) { double s = 0; for(int j = 0; j < 20; j++) s += close[i + j]; sma20[i] = s / 20; }
   for(int i = n - 20; i < n; i++) sma20[i] = sma20[MathMax(0, n - 21)];
   double eq = sma20[0];
   double discLow = low[ArrayMinimum(low, 0, 20)];
   double bid = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);
   if(discLow >= eq) return false;
   if(bid < discLow || bid > eq) return false; // pas en zone discount
   double zoneHeight = eq - discLow;
   double edgeThreshold = discLow + zoneHeight * 0.15; // bord inférieur = 15% du bas de la zone
   return (bid <= edgeThreshold);
}

// Protection capital: vrai si en zone Premium et prix au bord supérieur (zone de vente)
// Utilisé pour exiger confiance IA >= 85% avant d'exécuter un BUY sur Boom dans ce cas.
bool IsAtPremiumUpperEdge()
{
   double high[], low[], close[];
   ArraySetAsSeries(high, true); ArraySetAsSeries(low, true); ArraySetAsSeries(close, true);
   if(CopyHigh(_Symbol, PERIOD_H1, 0, 100, high) < 100 || CopyLow(_Symbol, PERIOD_H1, 0, 100, low) < 100 || CopyClose(_Symbol, PERIOD_H1, 0, 100, close) < 100) return false;
   int n = ArraySize(close);
   if(n < 25) return false;
   double sma20[];
   ArrayResize(sma20, n);
   ArraySetAsSeries(sma20, true);
   for(int i = 0; i < n - 20; i++) { double s = 0; for(int j = 0; j < 20; j++) s += close[i + j]; sma20[i] = s / 20; }
   for(int i = n - 20; i < n; i++) sma20[i] = sma20[MathMax(0, n - 21)];
   double eq = sma20[0];
   double premHigh = high[ArrayMaximum(high, 0, 20)];
   double ask = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK);
   if(premHigh <= eq) return false;
   if(ask < eq || ask > premHigh) return false; // pas en zone premium
   double zoneHeight = premHigh - eq;
   double edgeThreshold = premHigh - zoneHeight * 0.15; // bord supérieur = 15% du haut de la zone
   return (ask >= edgeThreshold);
}

bool PriceTouchesLowerChannel()
{
   string lowerName = "SMC_CH_H1_LOWER";
   if(ObjectFind(0, lowerName) < 0) return false;
   double lowerPrice = ObjectGetDouble(0, lowerName, OBJPROP_PRICE);
   if(lowerPrice <= 0) return false;
   double bid = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);
   double atrVal = 0;
   if(atrHandle != INVALID_HANDLE)
   {
      double atr[];
      ArraySetAsSeries(atr, true);
      if(CopyBuffer(atrHandle, 0, 0, 1, atr) >= 1) atrVal = atr[0];
   }
   if(atrVal <= 0) atrVal = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID) * 0.002;
   double tolerance = atrVal * 0.4;
   return (bid >= lowerPrice - tolerance && bid <= lowerPrice + tolerance);
}

bool PriceTouchesUpperChannel()
{
   string upperName = "SMC_CH_H1_UPPER";
   if(ObjectFind(0, upperName) < 0) return false;
   double upperPrice = ObjectGetDouble(0, upperName, OBJPROP_PRICE);
   if(upperPrice <= 0) return false;
   double ask = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK);
   double atrVal = 0;
   if(atrHandle != INVALID_HANDLE)
   {
      double atr[];
      ArraySetAsSeries(atr, true);
      if(CopyBuffer(atrHandle, 0, 0, 1, atr) >= 1) atrVal = atr[0];
   }
   if(atrVal <= 0) atrVal = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID) * 0.002;
   double tolerance = atrVal * 0.4;
   return (ask >= upperPrice - tolerance && ask <= upperPrice + tolerance);
}

void ExecuteFVGKillBuy()
{
   // Vérifier si l'ATR handle est valide
   if(atrHandle == INVALID_HANDLE) return;
   // STRATÉGIE UNIQUE SPIKE POUR BOOM/CRASH: ne pas utiliser FVG_Kill sur ces indices
   if(SMC_GetSymbolCategory(_Symbol) == SYM_BOOM_CRASH) return;
   
   double atr[];
   ArraySetAsSeries(atr, true);
   if(CopyBuffer(atrHandle, 0, 0, 1, atr) < 1) return;
   MqlRates r[];
   ArraySetAsSeries(r, true);
   if(CopyRates(_Symbol, LTF, 0, 3, r) < 3) return;
   double sl = r[1].low - atr[0] * ATR_Mult;
   double tp = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK) + (SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK) - sl) * 2.0;
   if(IsTerminalFull()) return;
   if(!TryAcquireOpenLock()) return;
   
   // Règle duplication / IA avant ouverture d'une nouvelle position
   if(!CanOpenAdditionalPositionForSymbol(_Symbol, "BUY"))
   {
      Print("❌ FVG_Kill BUY bloqué (règle duplication / IA) sur ", _Symbol);
      ReleaseOpenLock();
      return;
   }
   double lot = CalculateLotSize();
   if(lot <= 0) { ReleaseOpenLock(); return; }
   if(UseSniperScalperMode)
   {
      double askRef = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK);
      double slDistFVGB = MathAbs(askRef - sl);
      double tpDistFVGB = 0;
      if(!SMC_ApplySniperRiskCap(_Symbol, slDistFVGB, lot, tpDistFVGB))
      {
         Print("🚫 FVG_Kill BUY bloqué par Sniper Risk Cap sur ", _Symbol);
         ReleaseOpenLock();
         return;
      }
      tp = askRef + tpDistFVGB;
   }
   
   // Exiger une décision IA forte pour tous les marchés non Boom/Crash
   if(!IsAITradeAllowedForDirection("BUY"))
   {
      ReleaseOpenLock();
      return;
   }

   // Réentrée après perte sur ce symbole: exiger conditions exceptionnelles (context FVG = setup fort)
   if(!AllowReentryAfterRecentLoss(_Symbol, "BUY", false))
   {
      ReleaseOpenLock();
      return;
   }
   
   // Réinitialiser le gain maximum pour la nouvelle position
   g_maxProfit = 0;
   
    if(RequireSMCDerivArrowForAllOrders && !HasRecentSMCDerivArrowForDirection("BUY"))
    {
       Print("🚫 FVG_Kill BUY bloqué - Attendre flèche SMC_DERIV_ARROW BUY sur ", _Symbol);
       ReleaseOpenLock();
      return;
   }
   if(g_smcGomConnected && g_smcGomVerdictNum < 0)
   {
      Print("🚫 FVG_Kill BUY BLOQUÉ — GOM verdict=", g_smcGomVerdict, " (vn=", g_smcGomVerdictNum, ") — direction SELL");
      ReleaseOpenLock(); return;
   }
   if(g_smcGomConnected && g_smcGomVerdictNum == 0)
   {
      Print("🚫 FVG_Kill BUY BLOQUÉ — GOM verdict=WAIT (vn=0) — pas de direction");
      ReleaseOpenLock(); return;
   }
   if(!CanTradeOnSymbol(_Symbol, "BUY")) { Print("🚫 FVG_Kill BUY BLOQUÉ — Terminal plein, sens interdit, retournement ou ordre existant sur ", _Symbol); ReleaseOpenLock(); return; }
   if(!SMC_FinalOpenGate(_Symbol, ORDER_TYPE_BUY)) { ReleaseOpenLock(); return; }
   if(SafeTradeBuy(lot, _Symbol, 0, sl, tp, "FVG_Kill BUY"))
   {
      RegisterOrderPlaced();
      SMC_GateRegisterOpened(_Symbol, true);
      ulong ticket = trade.ResultOrder();
      if(ticket > 0) SMC_ApplyPostEntrySLBuffer(_Symbol, ticket, 1.0);
   }
   ReleaseOpenLock();
   if(trade.ResultRetcode() == TRADE_RETCODE_DONE && UseNotifications)
   { Alert("FVG_Kill BUY ", _Symbol); SendNotification("FVG_Kill BUY " + _Symbol); }
}
void ExecuteFVGKillSell()
{
   // Vérifier si l'ATR handle est valide
   if(atrHandle == INVALID_HANDLE) return;
   // STRATÉGIE UNIQUE SPIKE POUR BOOM/CRASH: ne pas utiliser FVG_Kill sur ces indices
   if(SMC_GetSymbolCategory(_Symbol) == SYM_BOOM_CRASH) return;
   
   double atr[];
   ArraySetAsSeries(atr, true);
   if(CopyBuffer(atrHandle, 0, 0, 1, atr) < 1) return;
   MqlRates r[];
   ArraySetAsSeries(r, true);
   if(CopyRates(_Symbol, LTF, 0, 3, r) < 3) return;
   double sl = r[1].high + atr[0] * ATR_Mult;
   double tp = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID) - (sl - SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID)) * 2.0;
   if(IsTerminalFull()) return;
   if(!TryAcquireOpenLock()) return;
   
   if(!CanOpenAdditionalPositionForSymbol(_Symbol, "SELL"))
   {
      Print("❌ FVG_Kill SELL bloqué (règle duplication / IA) sur ", _Symbol);
      ReleaseOpenLock();
      return;
   }
   double lot = CalculateLotSize();
   if(lot <= 0) { ReleaseOpenLock(); return; }
   if(UseSniperScalperMode)
   {
      double bidRef = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);
      double slDistFVGS = MathAbs(sl - bidRef);
      double tpDistFVGS = 0;
      if(!SMC_ApplySniperRiskCap(_Symbol, slDistFVGS, lot, tpDistFVGS))
      {
         Print("🚫 FVG_Kill SELL bloqué par Sniper Risk Cap sur ", _Symbol);
         ReleaseOpenLock();
         return;
      }
      tp = bidRef - tpDistFVGS;
   }
   
   // Exiger une décision IA forte pour tous les marchés non Boom/Crash
   if(!IsAITradeAllowedForDirection("SELL"))
   {
      ReleaseOpenLock();
      return;
   }

   // Réentrée après perte sur ce symbole: exiger conditions exceptionnelles (context FVG = setup fort)
   if(!AllowReentryAfterRecentLoss(_Symbol, "SELL", false))
   {
      ReleaseOpenLock();
      return;
   }
   
   // Réinitialiser le gain maximum pour la nouvelle position
   g_maxProfit = 0;
   
    if(RequireSMCDerivArrowForAllOrders && !HasRecentSMCDerivArrowForDirection("SELL"))
    {
       Print("🚫 FVG_Kill SELL bloqué - Attendre flèche SMC_DERIV_ARROW SELL sur ", _Symbol);
       ReleaseOpenLock();
      return;
   }
   if(g_smcGomConnected && g_smcGomVerdictNum > 0)
   {
      Print("🚫 FVG_Kill SELL BLOQUÉ — GOM verdict=", g_smcGomVerdict, " (vn=", g_smcGomVerdictNum, ") — direction BUY");
      ReleaseOpenLock(); return;
   }
   if(g_smcGomConnected && g_smcGomVerdictNum == 0)
   {
      Print("🚫 FVG_Kill SELL BLOQUÉ — GOM verdict=WAIT (vn=0) — pas de direction");
      ReleaseOpenLock(); return;
   }
   if(!CanTradeOnSymbol(_Symbol, "SELL")) { Print("🚫 FVG_Kill SELL BLOQUÉ — Terminal plein, sens interdit, retournement ou ordre existant sur ", _Symbol); ReleaseOpenLock(); return; }
   if(!SMC_FinalOpenGate(_Symbol, ORDER_TYPE_SELL)) { ReleaseOpenLock(); return; }
   if(SafeTradeSell(lot, _Symbol, 0, sl, tp, "FVG_Kill SELL"))
   {
      RegisterOrderPlaced();
      SMC_GateRegisterOpened(_Symbol, false);
      ulong ticket = trade.ResultOrder();
      if(ticket > 0) SMC_ApplyPostEntrySLBuffer(_Symbol, ticket, 1.0);
   }
   ReleaseOpenLock();
   if(trade.ResultRetcode() == TRADE_RETCODE_DONE && UseNotifications)
   { Alert("FVG_Kill SELL ", _Symbol); SendNotification("FVG_Kill SELL " + _Symbol); }
}

int CountPositionsForSymbol(string symbol)
{
   int n = 0;
   for(int i = PositionsTotal() - 1; i >= 0; i--)
   {
      ulong ticket = PositionGetTicket(i);
      if(ticket == 0) continue;
      if(PositionGetString(POSITION_SYMBOL) == symbol)
         n++;
   }
   return n;
}

// Retourne true si une position "SPIKE TRADE" est déjà ouverte sur ce symbole
bool HasOpenSpikeTradeForSymbol(string symbol)
{
   for(int i = PositionsTotal() - 1; i >= 0; i--)
   {
      if(!posInfo.SelectByIndex(i)) 
         continue;
      if(posInfo.Magic() != InpMagicNumber) 
         continue;
      if(posInfo.Symbol() != symbol) 
         continue;
      
      string comment = posInfo.Comment();
      if(StringFind(comment, "SPIKE TRADE") >= 0)
         return true;
   }
   return false;
}

int CountPositionsOurEA()
{
   int n = 0;
   for(int i = PositionsTotal() - 1; i >= 0; i--)
      if(posInfo.SelectByIndex(i) && posInfo.Magic() == InpMagicNumber)
         n++;
   return n;
}

//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| Anti-hedge ABSOLU : jamais BUY+SELL même symbole (notre magic)   |
//| Si état MIXED détecté → ferme la jambe la plus récente (ou la    |
